guide.summary: A chengyu is a fixed four-character phrase that packs a whole situation into one unit. The idea that makes it click: first pick the idiom by the situation (careless, hard-working, nervous, amazed), then use it the way its type allows. Most behave like adjectives that already mean 'very': predicate, 的 before a noun, 地 before a verb, no 很 in front. None of these takes a direct object.

subs.label: Careless, messy, flustered
subs.focus: 马马虎虎 (careless; also 'so-so'), 乱七八糟 (a total mess), 丢三落四 (always forgetting things), 手忙脚乱 (flustered rush), 三心二意 (half-hearted), 张冠李戴 (mixing up who did what). Items test which kind of carelessness the context describes.

subs.label: Effort, focus and giving up
subs.focus: 聚精会神, 全力以赴, 一丝不苟, 废寝忘食, 千方百计, 实事求是, and the opposite 半途而废. Typical errors: 半途而废 where 全力以赴 is meant; 一丝不苟 means meticulous about details, not just 'hard-working'.

subs.label: Feelings and manner
subs.focus: 兴高采烈 (in high spirits), 津津有味 (with relish), 迫不及待 (can't wait), 小心翼翼 (very carefully), 七上八下 (anxious), 恍然大悟 (sudden understanding), 一见钟情 (love at first sight). Typical error: 七上八下 used for excitement or joy.

subs.label: Judgments and attitudes
subs.focus: 莫名其妙 (baffling, no reason), 不可思议 (astonishing), 理所当然 (only natural), 无所谓 (I don't mind), 无论如何 (no matter what), 十全十美 (perfect), 九牛一毛 (a drop in the ocean). Typical error: confusing 莫名其妙 with 不可思议.

subs.label: Story idioms
subs.focus: 画蛇添足, 对牛弹琴, 井底之蛙, 守株待兔, 亡羊补牢, 自相矛盾: each judges a situation by an old story. Typical errors: reading 亡羊补牢 as 'too late' (it means fixing it is still worth it), and mixing it up with 守株待兔.

subs.label: Wishes and proverbs
subs.focus: 一路平安, 万事如意 (wishes after 祝你), 百闻不如一见, 熟能生巧, 入乡随俗, 一举两得 (said as a whole comment on a situation). Typical error: 一路平安 to someone who is not travelling.

subs.label: Everyday description
subs.focus: 讨价还价 (haggle), 各种各样 (all kinds of), 自言自语 (talk to oneself), 一模一样 (exactly the same), 脱口而出 (blurt out). Items test the situation and that 各种各样 goes before 的 + noun.

subs.label: Using an idiom in the sentence
subs.focus: Wrong grammatical use: 很 before 一模一样, 兴高采烈 or 十全十美; a direct object after 一见钟情 or 讨价还价 (needs 对 / 跟); 很 before noun idioms like 井底之蛙. Do not build errors on 的 vs 地 alone (natives mix them) or on 很乱七八糟. 不好意思 is not a chengyu: exclude it.

rules.rule: For a mess or a scramble: 乱七八糟 is a total mess, 丢三落四 is always forgetting things, 手忙脚乱 is a flustered rush, 张冠李戴 is mixing up who did or said what.
rules.pattern: Subject + idiom (+ 的) / idiom + 地 + Verb

examples.zh: 他的房间乱七八糟的。
examples.py: tā de fáng jiān luàn qī bā zāo de
examples.en: His room is a total mess.

examples.zh: 我总是丢三落四的，今天又忘了带钥匙。
examples.py: wǒ zǒng shì diū sān là sì de jīn tiān yòu wàng le dài yào shi
examples.en: I'm always forgetting things; today I forgot my keys again.

examples.zh: 早上起晚了，我手忙脚乱地出了门。
examples.py: zǎo shang qǐ wǎn le wǒ shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de chū le mén
examples.en: I overslept and rushed out of the house in a panic.

examples.zh: 这句话不是李老师说的，你张冠李戴了。
examples.py: zhè jù huà bù shì lǐ lǎo shī shuō de nǐ zhāng guān lǐ dài le
examples.en: Teacher Li didn't say that; you've mixed people up.

rules.note: 丢三落四 is read diū sān là sì: 落 is là here, not luò. 张冠李戴 is about wrong attribution, not general carelessness.

rules.rule: 马马虎虎 has two jobs: careless work (做事马马虎虎), and a modest 'so-so' answer about how something is. 三心二意 means not putting your whole mind on one thing.
rules.pattern: 做事马马虎虎 / X 马马虎虎 (so-so) / 不能三心二意

examples.zh: 他写作业总是马马虎虎的。
examples.py: tā xiě zuò yè zǒng shì mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ de
examples.en: He always does his homework carelessly.

examples.zh: 我的汉语马马虎虎，还要多练习。
examples.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ hái yào duō liàn xí
examples.en: My Chinese is so-so; I need more practice.

examples.zh: 学习不能三心二意。
examples.py: xué xí bù néng sān xīn èr yì
examples.en: You can't study half-heartedly.

rules.note: As 'so-so' it is modest, not an insult; about someone's work it is a criticism. The context decides which. Pinyin is mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ (the dictionary reading: second syllable neutral, last two first tone), although 马虎 alone is mǎ hu.

rules.rule: Focused hard work: 聚精会神 is full concentration, 一丝不苟 is meticulous to the last detail, 废寝忘食 is so absorbed you skip meals and sleep, 千方百计 is trying every possible way.
rules.pattern: idiom + 地 + Verb / Subject + 做事·工作 + idiom

examples.zh: 学生们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
examples.py: xué sheng men jù jīng huì shén de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè
examples.en: The students listened to the teacher with full attention.

examples.zh: 她工作一丝不苟。
examples.py: tā gōng zuò yī sī bù gǒu
examples.en: She is meticulous in her work.

examples.zh: 他废寝忘食地准备考试。
examples.py: tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de zhǔn bèi kǎo shì
examples.en: He is preparing for the exam so hard he forgets to eat and sleep.

examples.zh: 他千方百计地想找到那本书。
examples.py: tā qiān fāng bǎi jì de xiǎng zhǎo dào nà běn shū
examples.en: He tried every way he could to find that book.

rules.rule: 全力以赴 is giving everything to a task ahead; 实事求是 is sticking to the facts; 半途而废 is the opposite of effort: giving up halfway.
rules.pattern: 一定全力以赴 / 不要半途而废 / 要实事求是

examples.zh: 明天的比赛，我们一定全力以赴。
examples.py: míng tiān de bǐ sài wǒ men yī dìng quán lì yǐ fù
examples.en: We'll give everything we've got in tomorrow's match.

examples.zh: 学了一年了，不要半途而废。
examples.py: xué le yī nián le bù yào bàn tú ér fèi
examples.en: You've studied for a year now; don't give up halfway.

examples.zh: 写报告要实事求是。
examples.py: xiě bào gào yào shí shì qiú shì
examples.en: A report should stick to the facts.

rules.note: None of these takes an object: put the task first (明天的比赛，我们全力以赴), never after the idiom.

rules.rule: How someone does something: 兴高采烈 is in high spirits, 津津有味 is with relish (eating, reading, watching), 迫不及待 is unable to wait, 小心翼翼 is very carefully.
rules.pattern: idiom + 地 + Verb / Verb + 得 + 津津有味

examples.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地去公园了。
examples.py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de qù gōng yuán le
examples.en: The children went off to the park in high spirits.

examples.zh: 他吃得津津有味。
examples.py: tā chī de jīn jīn yǒu wèi
examples.en: He ate with obvious relish.

examples.zh: 她迫不及待地打开了礼物。
examples.py: tā pò bù jí dài de dǎ kāi le lǐ wù
examples.en: She couldn't wait to open the present.

examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地把杯子放在桌子上。
examples.py: tā xiǎo xīn yì yì de bǎ bēi zi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: He very carefully put the cup on the table.

rules.note: 兴 in 兴高采烈 is xìng, not xīng. 津津有味 very often follows 得 (看得津津有味).

rules.rule: Inner states: 七上八下 is anxious, heart pounding, never happy; 恍然大悟 is the sudden 'oh, now I get it'; 一见钟情 is love at first sight.
rules.pattern: 心里七上八下的 / 才·终于恍然大悟 / 对 + someone + 一见钟情

examples.zh: 成绩还没出来，我心里七上八下的。
examples.py: chéng jì hái méi chū lái wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de
examples.en: My results aren't out yet and I'm on edge.

examples.zh: 听了他的话，我才恍然大悟。
examples.py: tīng le tā de huà wǒ cái huǎng rán dà wù
examples.en: Only when I heard what he said did it suddenly click.

examples.zh: 他们俩是一见钟情。
examples.py: tā men liǎ shì yī jiàn zhōng qíng
examples.en: The two of them fell in love at first sight.

rules.note: 七上八下 almost always comes with 心里. 恍然大悟 needs something that caused the understanding (an explanation, a hint).

rules.rule: 莫名其妙: baffling, for no reason; 不可思议: astonishing, hard to believe; 理所当然: only natural, goes without saying; 无所谓: I don't mind, it makes no difference.
rules.pattern: 莫名其妙地 + Verb / 真不可思议 / 是理所当然的 / 都无所谓

examples.zh: 他莫名其妙地生气了。
examples.py: tā mò míng qí miào de shēng qì le
examples.en: He got angry for no apparent reason.

examples.zh: 这么小的孩子会说三种语言，真不可思议。
examples.py: zhè me xiǎo de hái zi huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán zhēn bù kě sī yì
examples.en: A child this small speaks three languages; it's incredible.

examples.zh: 父母照顾孩子是理所当然的。
examples.py: fù mǔ zhào gù hái zi shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de
examples.en: It's only natural for parents to look after their children.

examples.zh: 去哪里吃饭我都无所谓。
examples.py: qù nǎ lǐ chī fàn wǒ dōu wú suǒ wèi
examples.en: I don't mind where we eat.

rules.note: 莫名其妙 is negative (makes no sense); 不可思议 is amazement, often admiring. Answering 对不起 with 无所谓 sounds like 'whatever': say 没关系.

rules.rule: Story idioms judge a situation: 画蛇添足 is adding something unneeded that spoils it, 对牛弹琴 is talking to someone who can't appreciate it, 守株待兔 is waiting for luck, 亡羊补牢 is fixing things after a loss.
rules.pattern: 就是·简直是 + idiom / 不能 + idiom / 也算 + idiom

examples.zh: 文章已经很好了，再加这句就是画蛇添足。
examples.py: wén zhāng yǐ jīng hěn hǎo le zài jiā zhè jù jiù shì huà shé tiān zú
examples.en: The essay is already good; adding this sentence would only spoil it.

examples.zh: 跟他讲音乐就是对牛弹琴。
examples.py: gēn tā jiǎng yīn yuè jiù shì duì niú tán qín
examples.en: Talking about music with him is a waste of breath.

examples.zh: 想赚钱不能守株待兔。
examples.py: xiǎng zhuàn qián bù néng shǒu zhū dài tù
examples.en: If you want to make money, you can't just sit and wait for luck.

examples.zh: 被偷了一次以后，他才换了门锁，也算亡羊补牢。
examples.py: bèi tōu le yī cì yǐ hòu tā cái huàn le mén suǒ yě suàn wáng yáng bǔ láo
examples.en: He only changed the lock after being burgled, but better late than never.

rules.note: 亡羊补牢 is encouraging: it is not too late to fix. The other two story idioms, 井底之蛙 (a person with a narrow view, a noun) and 自相矛盾 (contradict oneself), are under the grammar rules.

rules.rule: Wishes and proverbs are said whole. Wishes follow 祝你: 一路平安 only to a traveller, 万事如意 for all the best. 百闻不如一见, 熟能生巧, 入乡随俗 comment on a situation.

examples.zh: 祝你一路平安，万事如意！
examples.py: zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān wàn shì rú yì
examples.en: Have a safe journey, and all the best!

examples.zh: 百闻不如一见，你应该自己去看看。
examples.py: bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn nǐ yīng gāi zì jǐ qù kàn kan
examples.en: Seeing is believing; you should go and see for yourself.

examples.zh: 别着急，熟能生巧。
examples.py: bié zháo jí shú néng shēng qiǎo
examples.en: Don't worry, practice makes perfect.

examples.zh: 入乡随俗，在中国我们也用筷子吃饭。
examples.py: rù xiāng suí sú zài zhōng guó wǒ men yě yòng kuài zi chī fàn
examples.en: When in Rome: in China we eat with chopsticks too.

rules.note: 一举两得 (one action, two gains) usually follows 真是 or 这样: 骑车上班又省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得.

rules.rule: 讨价还价 is haggling, 各种各样 is all kinds of (before 的 + noun), 自言自语 is talking to yourself, 脱口而出 is blurting something out without thinking.
rules.pattern: 跟 + person + 讨价还价 / 各种各样的 + Noun / 自言自语 / 脱口而出

examples.zh: 在市场买东西可以讨价还价。
examples.py: zài shì chǎng mǎi dōng xi kě yǐ tǎo jià huán jià
examples.en: You can haggle when you shop at the market.

examples.zh: 商店里有各种各样的水果。
examples.py: shāng diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shuǐ guǒ
examples.en: The shop has all kinds of fruit.

examples.zh: 他一边走一边自言自语。
examples.py: tā yī biān zǒu yī biān zì yán zì yǔ
examples.en: He talked to himself as he walked.

examples.zh: 那句话我没想就脱口而出了。
examples.py: nà jù huà wǒ méi xiǎng jiù tuō kǒu ér chū le
examples.en: I blurted that out without thinking.

rules.note: 还 in 讨价还价 is huán (give back), not hái. 模 in 一模一样 is mú.

rules.rule: Descriptive idioms act like adjectives that already mean 'very': use them as the predicate, with 的 before a noun, with 地 before a verb, or after 得. Do not put 很 in front of them.
rules.pattern: Subj + idiom / idiom + 的 + Noun / idiom + 地 + Verb / Verb + 得 + idiom

examples.zh: 这两张照片一模一样。
examples.py: zhè liǎng zhāng zhào piàn yī mú yī yàng
examples.en: These two photos are exactly the same.

examples.zh: 世界上没有十全十美的人。
examples.py: shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shí quán shí měi de rén
examples.en: Nobody in the world is perfect.

examples.zh: 大家兴高采烈地唱起歌来。
examples.py: dà jiā xìng gāo cǎi liè de chàng qǐ gē lái
examples.en: Everyone happily burst into song.

examples.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。
examples.py: zhè duì shuāng bāo tāi zhǎng de yī mú yī yàng
examples.en: These twins look exactly alike.

rules.note: Exceptions: judgment idioms like 不可思议 and 莫名其妙 do take 真, 太…了 or 很 (太不可思议了). 完全 may strengthen 一模一样.

rules.rule: Not every idiom is an adjective. Noun idioms follow 是 or 成为; 无论如何 comes before the verb phrase, with 都 or 也 after it; and none of these takes a direct object: the person goes in front with 对 or 跟.
rules.pattern: 是 + noun idiom / 无论如何 + 都 / 对·跟 + person + idiom

examples.zh: 不出去看看，就会成为井底之蛙。
examples.py: bù chū qù kàn kan jiù huì chéng wéi jǐng dǐ zhī wā
examples.en: If you never go out and see the world, you'll end up like a frog in a well.

examples.zh: 无论如何你都要来参加我的生日会。
examples.py: wú lùn rú hé nǐ dōu yào lái cān jiā wǒ de shēng rì huì
examples.en: You must come to my birthday party, no matter what.

examples.zh: 他说的话前后自相矛盾。
examples.py: tā shuō de huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn
examples.en: What he says contradicts itself.

examples.zh: 我对这个城市一见钟情。
examples.py: wǒ duì zhè ge chéng shì yī jiàn zhōng qíng
examples.en: I fell in love with this city at first sight.

rules.note: 不好意思 is an everyday phrase, not a chengyu, and is not drilled here.

right.py: wǒ duì tā yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
right.en: I fell for her at first sight.

contrasts.why: 一见钟情 cannot take an object. The person you fall for goes in front with 对.

contrasts.wrong: 这两件衣服很一模一样。

right.py: zhè liǎng jiàn yī fu yī mú yī yàng
right.en: These two pieces of clothing are exactly the same.

contrasts.why: 一模一样 already means 'exactly the same'; 很 cannot be added. Use it bare, or strengthen it with 完全.

contrasts.wrong: 她讨价还价了老板半天。

right.zh: 她跟老板讨价还价了半天。
right.py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le bàn tiān
right.en: She haggled with the shop owner for ages.

contrasts.why: 讨价还价 takes no object; the person you haggle with is introduced by 跟 before it.

right.py: tā jiù shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā
right.en: He's a real frog in a well.

contrasts.why: 井底之蛙 is a noun (a frog at the bottom of a well), not an adjective: use 是 and the measure 只, not 很.

contrasts.wrong: 这次比赛很重要，我们一定要半途而废。

right.zh: 这次比赛很重要，我们一定要全力以赴。
right.py: zhè cì bǐ sài hěn zhòng yào wǒ men yī dìng yào quán lì yǐ fù
right.en: This match matters; we must give it everything.

contrasts.why: 半途而废 means giving up halfway, the opposite of what an important match calls for. Going all out is 全力以赴.

contrasts.wrong: 听了老师的解释，我终于莫名其妙了。

right.zh: 听了老师的解释，我终于恍然大悟了。
right.py: tīng le lǎo shī de jiě shì wǒ zhōng yú huǎng rán dà wù le
right.en: After the teacher's explanation, it finally clicked.

contrasts.why: An explanation leads to sudden understanding, 恍然大悟. 莫名其妙 means something makes no sense, the opposite result.

contrasts.wrong: 这点钱对他来说只是十全十美。

right.zh: 这点钱对他来说只是九牛一毛。
right.py: zhè diǎn qián duì tā lái shuō zhǐ shì jiǔ niú yī máo
right.en: That bit of money is a drop in the ocean to him.

contrasts.why: A tiny amount compared with what someone has is 九牛一毛 (one hair from nine oxen). 十全十美 means perfect.

contrasts.wrong: 找工作不能亡羊补牢，要主动去找。

right.zh: 找工作不能守株待兔，要主动去找。
right.py: zhǎo gōng zuò bù néng shǒu zhū dài tù yào zhǔ dòng qù zhǎo
right.en: You can't just wait for a job to come to you; you have to go looking.

contrasts.why: Waiting passively for luck is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 is fixing a problem after a loss, which is a good thing to do.

contrasts.wrong: 帮助朋友是莫名其妙的事。

right.zh: 帮助朋友是理所当然的事。
right.py: bāng zhù péng you shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de shì
right.en: Helping your friends goes without saying.

contrasts.why: Something only natural is 理所当然. 莫名其妙 calls it baffling and senseless, which contradicts the meaning.

cheat: Messy or careless? 乱七八糟, 马马虎虎, 丢三落四. Working hard? 聚精会神, 一丝不苟, 全力以赴.
Idiom before a verb: 地. Before a noun: 的. After 得 is fine too.
No 很 before 一模一样, 兴高采烈, 十全十美: they are already extreme.
No object after an idiom: 对她一见钟情, 跟老板讨价还价.
亡羊补牢 = fix it, it's not too late. 守株待兔 = sitting waiting for luck.
莫名其妙 = makes no sense. 不可思议 = amazing. 理所当然 = of course.
一路平安 only to a traveller; answer 对不起 with 没关系, not 无所谓.

items.q: 他的书桌上___的，找不到作业本。
items.zh: 他的书桌上乱七八糟的，找不到作业本。
items.py: tā de shū zhuō shàng luàn qī bā zāo de zhǎo bù dào zuò yè běn
items.en: His desk is a total mess; he cannot find his exercise book.
items.why: A desk where nothing can be found is 乱七八糟, a total mess. 十全十美 (perfect) is the opposite, and 一模一样 (exactly alike) says nothing about order.

items.q: 小王做作业总是___，错字很多。
items.zh: 小王做作业总是马马虎虎，错字很多。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuò zuò yè zǒng shì mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ cuò zì hěn duō
items.en: Xiao Wang always does his homework carelessly; there are many wrong characters.
items.why: Many wrong characters show careless work: 马马虎虎. 一丝不苟 means meticulous, so it contradicts the clause about mistakes.

items.q: 我总是___，今天出门又忘了带手机。
items.zh: 我总是丢三落四，今天出门又忘了带手机。
items.py: wǒ zǒng shì diū sān là sì jīn tiān chū mén yòu wàng le dài shǒu jī
items.en: I am always forgetting things; today I left the house without my phone again.
items.why: Always forgetting things is 丢三落四 (read là, not luò). 半途而废 is about giving up halfway, and the other two do not describe a person who forgets.

items.q: 手机快没电了，他___地到处找充电器。
items.zh: 手机快没电了，他手忙脚乱地到处找充电器。
items.py: shǒu jī kuài méi diàn le tā shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de dào chù zhǎo chōng diàn qì
items.en: His phone was about to die, so he hunted for the charger in a flustered rush.
items.why: A hurried, flustered search is 手忙脚乱. 津津有味 (with relish) and 兴高采烈 (cheerful) do not fit a battery running out, and 一丝不苟 (meticulous) is the opposite of a panic.

items.q: 这件事是小李做的，你___了，别怪小王。
items.zh: 这件事是小李做的，你张冠李戴了，别怪小王。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì shì xiǎo lǐ zuò de nǐ zhāng guān lǐ dài le bié guài xiǎo wáng
items.en: Xiao Li did this; you have mixed people up, so do not blame Xiao Wang.
items.why: Pinning something on the wrong person is 张冠李戴 (one man's hat on another). The others are about talking to oneself, spoiling things, or wasted effort.

items.q: 你一边看手机一边写作业，这样___，两件事都做不好。
items.zh: 你一边看手机一边写作业，这样三心二意，两件事都做不好。
items.py: nǐ yī biān kàn shǒu jī yī biān xiě zuò yè zhè yàng sān xīn èr yì liǎng jiàn shì dōu zuò bù hǎo
items.en: If you check your phone while doing homework like that, you are half-hearted and will do neither well.
items.why: Splitting your attention between two things is 三心二意. The other three all describe full concentration, which is exactly what the sentence says is missing.

items.q: 考试只剩五分钟了，她还有三道题没写，急得___。
items.zh: 考试只剩五分钟了，她还有三道题没写，急得手忙脚乱。
items.py: kǎo shì zhǐ shèng wǔ fēn zhōng le tā hái yǒu sān dào tí méi xiě jí de shǒu máng jiǎo luàn
items.en: There were only five minutes left in the exam and she still had three questions to do; she was in a flustered rush.
items.why: Time pressure that makes someone rush and fumble is 手忙脚乱. 兴高采烈 and 津津有味 are happy states, and 理所当然 cannot follow 急得.

items.q: 我的衣柜里___，找不到那件蓝裙子。
items.zh: 我的衣柜里乱七八糟，找不到那件蓝裙子。
items.py: wǒ de yī guì lǐ luàn qī bā zāo zhǎo bù dào nà jiàn lán qún zi
items.en: My wardrobe is a total mess; I cannot find that blue skirt.
items.why: A wardrobe where you cannot find things is 乱七八糟. 万事如意 and 一路平安 are wishes, and 十全十美 means perfect.

items.q: 你游泳游得怎么样？我游得___，还要多练习。
items.zh: 你游泳游得怎么样？我游得马马虎虎，还要多练习。
items.py: nǐ yóu yǒng yóu de zěn me yàng wǒ yóu de mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ hái yào duō liàn xí
items.en: How is your swimming? So-so; I still need to practise more.
items.why: Answering "how is it?" modestly, "so-so", is 马马虎虎. The other idioms describe effort or care, not a modest rating, and "still need practice" fits a so-so level.

items.s: 我总是张冠李戴，出门忘带钥匙。
items.s_py: wǒ zǒng shì zhāng guān lǐ dài chū mén wàng dài yào shi
items.zh: 我总是丢三落四，出门忘带钥匙。
items.py: wǒ zǒng shì diū sān là sì chū mén wàng dài yào shi
items.en: I am always forgetting things; I forget my keys when I go out.
items.why: 张冠李戴 means mixing up who did or said what, not forgetting things. Always forgetting belongings is 丢三落四.

items.s: 弟弟写作业马马虎虎，老师让他重做。
items.s_py: dì di xiě zuò yè mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ lǎo shī ràng tā chóng zuò
items.zh: 弟弟写作业马马虎虎，老师让他重做。
items.py: dì di xiě zuò yè mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ lǎo shī ràng tā chóng zuò
items.en: My little brother did his homework carelessly, so the teacher made him redo it.
items.why: Correct. About someone's work, 马马虎虎 means careless, and being made to redo it fits that meaning.

items.q: 同学们___地听老师讲课。
items.zh: 同学们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
items.py: tóng xué men jù jīng huì shén de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè
items.en: The students listened to the teacher with full attention.
items.why: Listening with total concentration is 聚精会神 + 地 before the verb. 半途而废 is giving up, and 莫名其妙 or 七上八下 are not ways of listening.

items.q: 明天是篮球决赛，我们一定要___。
items.zh: 明天是篮球决赛，我们一定要全力以赴。
items.py: míng tiān shì lán qiú jué sài wǒ men yī dìng yào quán lì yǐ fù
items.en: Tomorrow is the basketball final; we must give it everything.
items.why: For an important final you give everything: 全力以赴. 半途而废 (quit halfway), 画蛇添足 (spoil by adding) and 马马虎虎 (careless) are all the wrong attitude.

items.q: 他学了一年钢琴就不学了，真是___。
items.zh: 他学了一年钢琴就不学了，真是半途而废。
items.py: tā xué le yī nián gāng qín jiù bù xué le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
items.en: He gave up the piano after one year; he really did quit halfway.
items.why: Starting something and stopping before it is finished is 半途而废. The other three describe working hard, which does not match quitting.

items.q: 他备考的时候___，常常一天只吃一顿饭。
items.zh: 他备考的时候废寝忘食，常常一天只吃一顿饭。
items.py: tā bèi kǎo de shí hou fèi qǐn wàng shí cháng cháng yī tiān zhǐ chī yī dùn fàn
items.en: When he was preparing for the exam he was so absorbed he forgot to eat and sleep, often eating only one meal a day.
items.why: Skipping meals because of work is the definition of 废寝忘食. 兴高采烈 is cheerful and 理所当然 means only natural; neither explains eating once a day.

items.q: 电脑坏了，修理店的人说没救了，他还是___地想把里面的照片救回来。
items.zh: 电脑坏了，修理店的人说没救了，他还是千方百计地想把里面的照片救回来。
items.py: diàn nǎo huài le xiū lǐ diàn de rén shuō méi jiù le tā hái shi qiān fāng bǎi jì de xiǎng bǎ lǐ miàn de zhào piàn jiù huí lái
items.en: His computer was broken and the repair shop said it was hopeless, but he still tried every way to save the photos on it.
items.why: Trying every possible means despite bad news is 千方百计 + 地. 半途而废 would mean he gave up, which 还是 contradicts.

items.q: 她做事一向___，连作业本上的标点都要检查三遍。
items.zh: 她做事一向一丝不苟，连作业本上的标点都要检查三遍。
items.py: tā zuò shì yī xiàng yī sī bù gǒu lián zuò yè běn shàng de biāo diǎn dōu yào jiǎn chá sān biàn
items.en: She has always been meticulous; she even checks the punctuation in her exercise book three times.
items.why: Checking even punctuation three times is meticulous to the last detail: 一丝不苟. The other three are careless or distracted, so 连...都 makes no sense with them.

items.q: 写调查报告要___，不能为了好看改数字。
items.zh: 写调查报告要实事求是，不能为了好看改数字。
items.py: xiě diào chá bào gào yào shí shì qiú shì bù néng wèi le hǎo kàn gǎi shù zì
items.en: A survey report has to stick to the facts; you cannot change the numbers to make it look better.
items.why: Not altering numbers means sticking to the facts: 实事求是. 一见钟情 is about love, 画蛇添足 is about adding something unneeded, and 小心翼翼 describes how you move.

items.q: 考试时他___地做题，连旁边有人咳嗽也没听见。
items.zh: 考试时他聚精会神地做题，连旁边有人咳嗽也没听见。
items.py: kǎo shì shí tā jù jīng huì shén de zuò tí lián páng biān yǒu rén ké sou yě méi tīng jiàn
items.en: During the exam he was so absorbed in the questions that he did not even hear someone coughing next to him.
items.why: Not hearing a cough means total concentration: 聚精会神. 手忙脚乱 would mean panic, which does not explain missing the noise, and 讨价还价 is haggling.

items.q: 比赛只剩最后五分钟了，我们必须___，不能放弃。
items.zh: 比赛只剩最后五分钟了，我们必须全力以赴，不能放弃。
items.py: bǐ sài zhǐ shèng zuì hòu wǔ fēn zhōng le wǒ men bì xū quán lì yǐ fù bù néng fàng qì
items.en: Only five minutes of the match remain; we must give it everything and not give up.
items.why: "Must not give up" goes with giving everything: 全力以赴. The other idioms are about love, contradiction or variety and do not fit the pep talk.

items.s: 他全力以赴这次考试。
items.s_py: tā quán lì yǐ fù zhè cì kǎo shì
items.zh: 他为这次考试全力以赴。
items.py: tā wèi zhè cì kǎo shì quán lì yǐ fù
items.en: He gave it everything for this exam.
items.why: 全力以赴 does not take a direct object. The task is introduced with 为 (or put first) and the idiom comes last.

items.s: 他废寝忘食地写代码，连午饭都忘了吃。
items.s_py: tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de xiě dài mǎ lián wǔ fàn dōu wàng le chī
items.zh: 他废寝忘食地写代码，连午饭都忘了吃。
items.py: tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de xiě dài mǎ lián wǔ fàn dōu wàng le chī
items.en: He wrote code so intensely he forgot to eat and sleep; he even forgot lunch.
items.why: Correct. 废寝忘食 works as an adverbial with 地 before the verb, and forgetting lunch matches its meaning.

items.q: 做数学题要___，不能一边玩一边做。
items.zh: 做数学题要聚精会神，不能一边玩一边做。
items.py: zuò shù xué tí yào jù jīng huì shén bù néng yī biān wán yī biān zuò
items.en: You have to concentrate on maths problems; you cannot play while doing them.
items.why: "Cannot play while doing them" asks for full concentration: 聚精会神. The other options say nothing about attention.

items.q: 为了买到那双限量版球鞋，他___地找了好几家店。
items.zh: 为了买到那双限量版球鞋，他千方百计地找了好几家店。
items.py: wèi le mǎi dào nà shuāng xiàn liàng bǎn qiú xié tā qiān fāng bǎi jì de zhǎo le hǎo jǐ jiā diàn
items.en: To get that limited-edition pair of trainers, he tried every way he could and searched several shops.
items.why: Going to great lengths to get something is 千方百计 + 地 before the verb. 一见钟情 and 自相矛盾 cannot modify a verb like this, and 各种各样 needs 的 before a noun.

items.q: 放假了，孩子们___地去公园玩。
items.zh: 放假了，孩子们兴高采烈地去公园玩。
items.py: fàng jià le hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de qù gōng yuán wán
items.en: The holiday began and the children went off to the park in high spirits.
items.why: A holiday makes children cheerful: 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety and 莫名其妙 means baffling.

items.q: 他一边看球赛一边吃西瓜，吃得___。
items.zh: 他一边看球赛一边吃西瓜，吃得津津有味。
items.py: tā yī biān kàn qiú sài yī biān chī xī guā chī de jīn jīn yǒu wèi
items.en: He ate watermelon while watching the match, and ate with relish.
items.why: Eating with obvious enjoyment is 吃得津津有味. 七上八下 is anxious and 半途而废 is quitting, neither describes enjoying food.

items.q: 新手机刚到，弟弟连饭都顾不上吃，___地拆开了盒子。
items.zh: 新手机刚到，弟弟连饭都顾不上吃，迫不及待地拆开了盒子。
items.py: xīn shǒu jī gāng dào dì di lián fàn dōu gù bù shàng chī pò bù jí dài de chāi kāi le hé zi
items.en: The new phone had just arrived and my little brother, not even stopping for dinner, could not wait to tear open the box.
items.why: Too eager to even eat is 迫不及待 (unable to wait). The other options do not describe eagerness.

items.q: 那只猫很胆小，我___地把它从树上抱了下来。
items.zh: 那只猫很胆小，我小心翼翼地把它从树上抱了下来。
items.py: nà zhī māo hěn dǎn xiǎo wǒ xiǎo xīn yì yì de bǎ tā cóng shù shàng bào le xià lái
items.en: The cat was very timid, so I lifted it down from the tree very carefully.
items.why: Handling a timid animal gently is 小心翼翼 + 地. 兴高采烈 (cheerful) is a mood, not a way of handling, and the others do not fit.

items.q: 明天就要公布考试成绩了，我心里___的，晚上睡不着。
items.zh: 明天就要公布考试成绩了，我心里七上八下的，晚上睡不着。
items.py: míng tiān jiù yào gōng bù kǎo shì chéng jì le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo
items.en: Tomorrow the exam results come out; I am on edge and cannot sleep tonight.
items.why: Anxiety before results, with 心里, is 七上八下. 兴高采烈 would mean cheerful, which does not explain not sleeping.

items.q: 听了老师的解释，我___，原来这个字是这样用的。
items.zh: 听了老师的解释，我恍然大悟，原来这个字是这样用的。
items.py: tīng le lǎo shī de jiě shì wǒ huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zhè ge zì shì zhè yàng yòng de
items.en: After the teacher's explanation it suddenly clicked: so that is how this character is used.
items.why: An explanation leading to sudden understanding, followed by 原来, is 恍然大悟. The other options do not describe understanding.

items.q: 他对这只小狗___，当天就把它带回了家。
items.zh: 他对这只小狗一见钟情，当天就把它带回了家。
items.py: tā duì zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng dāng tiān jiù bǎ tā dài huí le jiā
items.en: He fell for this puppy at first sight and took it home the same day.
items.why: Instant attachment with 对 + target is 一见钟情. 迫不及待 and 理所当然 do not fit after 对 + a thing, and 莫名其妙 would mean unreasonable.

items.q: 奶奶戴着老花镜，看手机里的短视频看得___。
items.zh: 奶奶戴着老花镜，看手机里的短视频看得津津有味。
items.py: nǎi nai dài zhe lǎo huā jìng kàn shǒu jī lǐ de duǎn shì pín kàn de jīn jīn yǒu wèi
items.en: Grandma, wearing her reading glasses, watched the short videos on the phone with great relish.
items.why: After 看得, absorbed enjoyment is 津津有味. 七上八下 is anxiety, 半途而废 is quitting, and 万事如意 is a wish, not a way of watching.

items.q: 球队赢了比赛，球迷们___地唱起歌来。
items.zh: 球队赢了比赛，球迷们兴高采烈地唱起歌来。
items.py: qiú duì yíng le bǐ sài qiú mí men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chàng qǐ gē lái
items.en: The team won, and the fans burst into song in high spirits.
items.why: Winning makes fans cheerful, so 兴高采烈地唱起歌来. 七上八下 and 小心翼翼 do not fit singing, and 聚精会神 is about concentration.

items.q: 朋友说点屏幕上那个小图标就行，我这才___。
items.zh: 朋友说点屏幕上那个小图标就行，我这才恍然大悟。
items.py: péng you shuō diǎn píng mù shàng nà ge xiǎo tú biāo jiù xíng wǒ zhè cái huǎng rán dà wù
items.en: My friend said to tap that little icon on the screen, and only then did I suddenly get it.
items.why: 这才 marks the moment of understanding after a hint: 恍然大悟. 莫名其妙 would mean it still made no sense.

items.q: 妈妈给我买了新裙子，我___地穿上它去上学。
items.zh: 妈妈给我买了新裙子，我兴高采烈地穿上它去上学。
items.py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le xīn qún zi wǒ xìng gāo cǎi liè de chuān shàng tā qù shàng xué
items.en: Mum bought me a new skirt and I happily put it on and went to school.
items.why: A new skirt makes a child cheerful: 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety and 半途而废 is quitting.

items.q: 听说新的网络游戏今天上线，他___地打开了电脑。
items.zh: 听说新的网络游戏今天上线，他迫不及待地打开了电脑。
items.py: tīng shuō xīn de wǎng luò yóu xì jīn tiān shàng xiàn tā pò bù jí dài de dǎ kāi le diàn nǎo
items.en: He heard the new online game was launching today and could not wait to switch on his computer.
items.why: Eagerness for a launch is 迫不及待. 小心翼翼 and 一丝不苟 are about care and do not suit switching on a computer, and 莫名其妙 means baffling.

items.s: 成绩快出来了，我心里兴高采烈的。
items.s_py: chéng jì kuài chū lái le wǒ xīn li xìng gāo cǎi liè de
items.zh: 成绩快出来了，我心里七上八下的。
items.py: chéng jì kuài chū lái le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de
items.en: The results are about to come out and I am on edge.
items.why: 兴高采烈 describes outward joy and does not go with 心里 while waiting. Nervous waiting is 心里七上八下.

items.s: 他对这条裙子一见钟情，马上买了下来。
items.s_py: tā duì zhè tiáo qún zi yī jiàn zhōng qíng mǎ shàng mǎi le xià lái
items.zh: 他对这条裙子一见钟情，马上买了下来。
items.py: tā duì zhè tiáo qún zi yī jiàn zhōng qíng mǎ shàng mǎi le xià lái
items.en: He fell for this dress at first sight and bought it straight away.
items.why: Correct. 一见钟情 can be used for things as well as people, with 对 introducing what is loved.

items.s: 弟弟很兴高采烈地玩游戏。
items.s_py: dì di hěn xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán yóu xì
items.zh: 弟弟兴高采烈地玩游戏。
items.py: dì di xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán yóu xì
items.en: My little brother plays the game in high spirits.
items.why: 兴高采烈 already means very cheerful, so 很 cannot be put in front. Use it bare.

items.q: 我的手机明明放在包里，现在却不见了，真___。
items.zh: 我的手机明明放在包里，现在却不见了，真莫名其妙。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī míng míng fàng zài bāo lǐ xiàn zài què bù jiàn le zhēn mò míng qí miào
items.en: My phone was clearly in my bag and now it has vanished; it makes no sense.
items.why: Something that happens for no understandable reason is 莫名其妙. 理所当然 means only natural, which is the opposite of a surprise.

items.q: 三岁的孩子会用平板电脑写字，真___。
items.zh: 三岁的孩子会用平板电脑写字，真不可思议。
items.py: sān suì de hái zi huì yòng píng bǎn diàn nǎo xiě zì zhēn bù kě sī yì
items.en: A three-year-old who can write on a tablet is amazing.
items.why: Astonishment at something hard to believe is 不可思议. 无所谓 means indifferent, which is not how one reacts to this.

items.q: 你想吃火锅还是烧烤？我___，你决定吧。
items.zh: 你想吃火锅还是烧烤？我无所谓，你决定吧。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī huǒ guō hái shi shāo kǎo wǒ wú suǒ wèi nǐ jué dìng ba
items.en: Do you want hotpot or barbecue? I don't mind; you decide.
items.why: Handing the choice over means "I don't mind": 无所谓. 迫不及待 would insist on one choice.

items.q: 学生按时交作业是___的事。
items.zh: 学生按时交作业是理所当然的事。
items.py: xué sheng àn shí jiāo zuò yè shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de shì
items.en: Students handing in their homework on time is only natural.
items.why: Something that goes without saying is 理所当然 + 的 before 事. 莫名其妙 and 不可思议 call it baffling or amazing, and 十全十美 (perfect) says nothing about duty.

items.q: 这件外套太好看了，我___都要买。
items.zh: 这件外套太好看了，我无论如何都要买。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào tài hǎo kàn le wǒ wú lùn rú hé dōu yào mǎi
items.en: This jacket is so nice; I will buy it no matter what.
items.why: 无论如何 + 都 means "no matter what". The other options cannot go before 都要买 with that meaning.

items.q: 买衣服时别太挑剔，世界上没有___的东西。
items.zh: 买衣服时别太挑剔，世界上没有十全十美的东西。
items.py: mǎi yī fu shí bié tài tiāo tī shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shí quán shí měi de dōng xi
items.en: Do not be too picky when buying clothes; nothing in the world is perfect.
items.why: "Too picky" goes with "nothing is perfect": 十全十美. 九牛一毛 is a tiny amount, and the other two do not describe a thing.

items.q: 他一个月赚好几万，这两百块钱对他来说只是___。
items.zh: 他一个月赚好几万，这两百块钱对他来说只是九牛一毛。
items.py: tā yī gè yuè zhuàn hǎo jǐ wàn zhè liǎng bǎi kuài qián duì tā lái shuō zhǐ shì jiǔ niú yī máo
items.en: He earns tens of thousands a month; two hundred yuan is a drop in the ocean to him.
items.why: A tiny sum next to a large income is 九牛一毛. 十全十美 means perfect and 一举两得 means two gains from one action.

items.q: 我的网课老师讲得很快，我听得___，一点也不明白。
items.zh: 我的网课老师讲得很快，我听得莫名其妙，一点也不明白。
items.py: wǒ de wǎng kè lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn kuài wǒ tīng de mò míng qí miào yī diǎn yě bù míng bai
items.en: My online teacher speaks fast; I listen completely baffled and understand nothing.
items.why: "Understand nothing" means baffled: 听得莫名其妙. 津津有味 and 兴高采烈 are enjoyment, and 恍然大悟 is sudden understanding.

items.q: 不管下雨还是晴天，他都___，反正每天都去跑步。
items.zh: 不管下雨还是晴天，他都无所谓，反正每天都去跑步。
items.py: bù guǎn xià yǔ hái shi qíng tiān tā dōu wú suǒ wèi fǎn zhèng měi tiān dōu qù pǎo bù
items.en: Rain or shine he doesn't mind; he goes running every day anyway.
items.why: Rain or shine makes no difference to him: 无所谓. 七上八下 is anxiety, and 不可思议 would call the weather astonishing.

items.q: 我借了朋友的书，按时还给他是___的。
items.zh: 我借了朋友的书，按时还给他是理所当然的。
items.py: wǒ jiè le péng you de shū àn shí huán gěi tā shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de
items.en: I borrowed a friend's book; giving it back on time is only natural.
items.why: Returning a borrowed book on time goes without saying: 理所当然 + 的. 莫名其妙 and 不可思议 would call it baffling or incredible.

items.q: 这只鹦鹉竟然能背出整首诗，太___了。
items.zh: 这只鹦鹉竟然能背出整首诗，太不可思议了。
items.py: zhè zhī yīng wǔ jìng rán néng bèi chū zhěng shǒu shī tài bù kě sī yì le
items.en: This parrot can actually recite a whole poem; it is incredible.
items.why: 竟然 signals surprise, and 太...了 with 不可思议 expresses amazement. 理所当然 would say it is only natural, contradicting 竟然.

items.q: 红的蓝的我都___，你帮我选一件就行。
items.zh: 红的蓝的我都无所谓，你帮我选一件就行。
items.py: hóng de lán de wǒ dōu wú suǒ wèi nǐ bāng wǒ xuǎn yī jiàn jiù xíng
items.en: I don't mind red or blue; just pick one for me.
items.why: Not caring which colour is 无所谓. The other options are wishes or descriptions of mess and perfection.

items.s: 同桌没有原因就不理我了，真是理所当然。
items.s_py: tóng zhuō méi yǒu yuán yīn jiù bù lǐ wǒ le zhēn shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán
items.zh: 同桌没有原因就不理我了，真是莫名其妙。
items.py: tóng zhuō méi yǒu yuán yīn jiù bù lǐ wǒ le zhēn shì mò míng qí miào
items.en: My desk mate stopped talking to me for no reason; it makes no sense.
items.why: Doing something with no reason is 莫名其妙. 理所当然 means only natural, which contradicts 没有原因.

items.s: 这么小的手机竟能放下一千首歌，真不可思议。
items.s_py: zhè me xiǎo de shǒu jī jìng néng fàng xià yī qiān shǒu gē zhēn bù kě sī yì
items.zh: 这么小的手机竟能放下一千首歌，真不可思议。
items.py: zhè me xiǎo de shǒu jī jìng néng fàng xià yī qiān shǒu gē zhēn bù kě sī yì
items.en: A phone this small can hold a thousand songs; it is incredible.
items.why: Correct. 不可思议 can take 真 and expresses admiring amazement, which fits 竟能.

items.q: 这篇作文已经写得很完整了，再加一段就是___。
items.zh: 这篇作文已经写得很完整了，再加一段就是画蛇添足。
items.py: zhè piān zuò wén yǐ jīng xiě de hěn wán zhěng le zài jiā yī duàn jiù shì huà shé tiān zú
items.en: This essay is already complete; adding another paragraph would only spoil it.
items.why: Adding something unneeded to something already finished is 画蛇添足. The other story idioms are about audience, waiting for luck, or repairing a loss.

items.q: 你跟没学过篮球的人讲战术，真是___。
items.zh: 你跟没学过篮球的人讲战术，真是对牛弹琴。
items.py: nǐ gēn méi xué guò lán qiú de rén jiǎng zhàn shù zhēn shì duì niú tán qín
items.en: Explaining tactics to someone who has never played basketball is like playing the lute to a cow.
items.why: Talking to someone who cannot understand is 对牛弹琴. 画蛇添足 is adding something unneeded, which is not the issue here.

items.q: 想考好就得每天复习，不能___，等着好运气自己来。
items.zh: 想考好就得每天复习，不能守株待兔，等着好运气自己来。
items.py: xiǎng kǎo hǎo jiù děi měi tiān fù xí bù néng shǒu zhū dài tù děng zhe hǎo yùn qi zì jǐ lái
items.en: To do well you have to review every day; you cannot sit and wait for good luck to come.
items.why: Waiting passively for luck is 守株待兔. 废寝忘食 is working too hard, the opposite, and 亡羊补牢 is about repairing a loss.

items.q: 手机被偷以后，他才给手机设了密码，不过这也算___。
items.zh: 手机被偷以后，他才给手机设了密码，不过这也算亡羊补牢。
items.py: shǒu jī bèi tōu yǐ hòu tā cái gěi shǒu jī shè le mì mǎ bù guò zhè yě suàn wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.en: Only after his phone was stolen did he set a password, but at least that is better late than never.
items.why: Fixing a problem after a loss is 亡羊补牢, and it is encouraging, not a criticism. 守株待兔 is passive waiting and 画蛇添足 is spoiling by adding.

items.q: 整天只玩手机，不出去看看世界，你会变成___。
items.zh: 整天只玩手机，不出去看看世界，你会变成井底之蛙。
items.py: zhěng tiān zhǐ wán shǒu jī bù chū qù kàn kan shì jiè nǐ huì biàn chéng jǐng dǐ zhī wā
items.en: If you only play on your phone all day and never go out to see the world, you will become a frog in a well.
items.why: 变成 needs a noun, and 井底之蛙 is a noun for someone with a narrow view. 九牛一毛 and 各种各样 are not nouns for a person, and 一路平安 is a wish.

items.q: 他一会儿说喜欢小狗，一会儿又说讨厌小狗，这不是___吗？
items.zh: 他一会儿说喜欢小狗，一会儿又说讨厌小狗，这不是自相矛盾吗？
items.py: tā yī huì r shuō xǐ huan xiǎo gǒu yī huì r yòu shuō tǎo yàn xiǎo gǒu zhè bù shì zì xiāng máo dùn ma
items.en: One moment he says he likes dogs, the next he says he hates them; isn't he contradicting himself?
items.why: Saying two things that cancel each other out is 自相矛盾. 一模一样 would mean the two statements are identical, but here they are opposites; the other two do not describe what someone says.

items.q: 这条裙子本来就很漂亮，你再加一条腰带反而成了___。
items.zh: 这条裙子本来就很漂亮，你再加一条腰带反而成了画蛇添足。
items.py: zhè tiáo qún zi běn lái jiù hěn piào liang nǐ zài jiā yī tiáo yāo dài fǎn ér chéng le huà shé tiān zú
items.en: The skirt was pretty already; adding a belt only made it worse.
items.why: An unneeded addition that spoils something good is 画蛇添足. 一举两得 would mean the belt brought two gains, the opposite of 反而.

items.q: 我对着小猫讲了半天道理，它只管睡觉，我真是___。
items.zh: 我对着小猫讲了半天道理，它只管睡觉，我真是对牛弹琴。
items.py: wǒ duì zhe xiǎo māo jiǎng le bàn tiān dào lǐ tā zhǐ guǎn shuì jiào wǒ zhēn shì duì niú tán qín
items.en: I lectured the kitten for ages and it just kept sleeping; I was wasting my breath.
items.why: Talking to someone who does not take it in is 对牛弹琴. 亡羊补牢 is repairing after a loss and 一举两得 is a double gain.

items.q: 他每天只是刷手机，等着有人给他介绍工作，这样___，是找不到工作的。
items.zh: 他每天只是刷手机，等着有人给他介绍工作，这样守株待兔，是找不到工作的。
items.py: tā měi tiān zhǐ shì shuā shǒu jī děng zhe yǒu rén gěi tā jiè shào gōng zuò zhè yàng shǒu zhū dài tù shì zhǎo bù dào gōng zuò de
items.en: He just scrolls his phone all day waiting for someone to find him a job; sitting and waiting like that, he will not find work.
items.why: Waiting for luck to arrive is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 is about repairing, 一举两得 is a double gain, and 入乡随俗 is following local customs.

items.s: 考砸了以后，他才开始每天复习，这是守株待兔。
items.s_py: kǎo zá le yǐ hòu tā cái kāi shǐ měi tiān fù xí zhè shì shǒu zhū dài tù
items.zh: 考砸了以后，他才开始每天复习，这是亡羊补牢。
items.py: kǎo zá le yǐ hòu tā cái kāi shǐ měi tiān fù xí zhè shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.en: He only began reviewing every day after failing; better late than never.
items.why: Taking action after a failure is 亡羊补牢. 守株待兔 means sitting waiting for luck, the opposite of working.

items.s: 他说话前后自相矛盾，所以没有人相信他。
items.s_py: tā shuō huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén xiāng xìn tā
items.zh: 他说话前后自相矛盾，所以没有人相信他。
items.py: tā shuō huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén xiāng xìn tā
items.en: What he says contradicts itself, so nobody believes him.
items.why: Correct. 自相矛盾 works as a predicate after 前后, and contradicting oneself is a good reason not to be believed.

items.s: 他很井底之蛙，从来没出过远门。
items.s_py: tā hěn jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi chū guò yuǎn mén
items.zh: 他就是一只井底之蛙，从来没出过远门。
items.py: tā jiù shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi chū guò yuǎn mén
items.en: He is a real frog in a well; he has never travelled far.
items.why: 井底之蛙 is a noun (a frog), not an adjective, so 很 cannot precede it. Use 是 with a measure word such as 一只.

items.q: 你明天要坐飞机去上海了，祝你___！
items.zh: 你明天要坐飞机去上海了，祝你一路平安！
items.py: nǐ míng tiān yào zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi le zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.en: You are flying to Shanghai tomorrow; have a safe journey!
items.why: To someone about to travel, the wish is 一路平安. The other options are proverbs or a feeling, not wishes after 祝你.

items.q: 新的一年开始了，祝你身体健康，___！
items.zh: 新的一年开始了，祝你身体健康，万事如意！
items.py: xīn de yī nián kāi shǐ le zhù nǐ shēn tǐ jiàn kāng wàn shì rú yì
items.en: The new year has begun; I wish you good health and all the best!
items.why: A general wish for the new year is 万事如意. 一路平安 is only for someone travelling.

items.q: 我练了很多遍，现在打字越来越快了，真是___。
items.zh: 我练了很多遍，现在打字越来越快了，真是熟能生巧。
items.py: wǒ liàn le hěn duō biàn xiàn zài dǎ zì yuè lái yuè kuài le zhēn shì shú néng shēng qiǎo
items.en: I practised many times and now I type faster and faster; practice makes perfect.
items.why: Improvement through repetition is 熟能生巧. 百闻不如一见 is about seeing for yourself, and 入乡随俗 is about local customs.

items.q: 网上看了很多次，这次亲眼看到大熊猫才明白，真是___。
items.zh: 网上看了很多次，这次亲眼看到大熊猫才明白，真是百闻不如一见。
items.py: wǎng shàng kàn le hěn duō cì zhè cì qīn yǎn kàn dào dà xióng māo cái míng bai zhēn shì bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
items.en: I had looked at pandas online many times, but only seeing one in person made it clear: seeing is believing.
items.why: Hearing or reading many times is not as good as seeing once: 百闻不如一见, and 亲眼 points to it.

items.q: 骑自行车上班，又省钱又锻炼身体，真是___。
items.zh: 骑自行车上班，又省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
items.py: qí zì xíng chē shàng bān yòu shěng qián yòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
items.en: Cycling to work saves money and gets you exercise; two birds with one stone.
items.why: One action with two gains is 一举两得. 画蛇添足 means an addition that spoils things, which does not match two benefits.

items.q: 在国外的餐厅要给小费，___，我们也给吧。
items.zh: 在国外的餐厅要给小费，入乡随俗，我们也给吧。
items.py: zài guó wài de cān tīng yào gěi xiǎo fèi rù xiāng suí sú wǒ men yě gěi ba
items.en: In restaurants abroad you tip; when in Rome, let us tip too.
items.why: Following local customs is 入乡随俗. The other options are a feeling, talking to oneself, or a travel wish.

items.s: 朋友在家生病了，我说祝你一路平安。
items.s_py: péng you zài jiā shēng bìng le wǒ shuō zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.zh: 朋友在家生病了，我说祝你早日康复。
items.py: péng you zài jiā shēng bìng le wǒ shuō zhù nǐ zǎo rì kāng fù
items.en: My friend was ill at home, and I said I hope you recover soon.
items.why: 一路平安 is only for someone setting off on a journey. A friend ill at home gets 祝你早日康复.

items.s: 你每天说几句汉语，熟能生巧，进步会很快。
items.s_py: nǐ měi tiān shuō jǐ jù hàn yǔ shú néng shēng qiǎo jìn bù huì hěn kuài
items.zh: 你每天说几句汉语，熟能生巧，进步会很快。
items.py: nǐ měi tiān shuō jǐ jù hàn yǔ shú néng shēng qiǎo jìn bù huì hěn kuài
items.en: Say a few sentences of Chinese every day; practice makes perfect and you will progress fast.
items.why: Correct. 熟能生巧 is a proverb said as a whole comment, with the advice before or after it.

items.q: 刚到一个新国家，要___，多了解当地的习惯。
items.zh: 刚到一个新国家，要入乡随俗，多了解当地的习惯。
items.py: gāng dào yī gè xīn guó jiā yào rù xiāng suí sú duō liǎo jiě dāng dì de xí guàn
items.en: When you have just arrived in a new country, follow local customs and learn about local habits.
items.why: Adapting to local habits in a new place is 入乡随俗. 熟能生巧 would be about practice, which the sentence does not mention.

items.q: 在小店买衣服可以___，老板会便宜一点儿。
items.zh: 在小店买衣服可以讨价还价，老板会便宜一点儿。
items.py: zài xiǎo diàn mǎi yī fu kě yǐ tǎo jià huán jià lǎo bǎn huì pián yi yī diǎn r
items.en: You can haggle when buying clothes at a small shop; the owner will take a little off.
items.why: Bargaining over the price is 讨价还价. The other idioms have nothing to do with price.

items.q: 鞋店里有___的鞋，样子和颜色都不一样。
items.zh: 鞋店里有各种各样的鞋，样子和颜色都不一样。
items.py: xié diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de xié yàng zi hé yán sè dōu bù yī yàng
items.en: The shoe shop has all kinds of shoes, all different in style and colour.
items.why: "All kinds of" before 的 + noun is 各种各样. 一模一样 would mean identical, contradicting 都不一样.

items.q: 他一个人在房间里___，好像在背课文。
items.zh: 他一个人在房间里自言自语，好像在背课文。
items.py: tā yī gè rén zài fáng jiān lǐ zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài bèi kè wén
items.en: He is alone in his room talking to himself, as if learning a text by heart.
items.why: Talking to oneself when alone is 自言自语. 讨价还价 needs another person to haggle with.

items.q: 老师刚问完问题，他想都没想，答案就___了。
items.zh: 老师刚问完问题，他想都没想，答案就脱口而出了。
items.py: lǎo shī gāng wèn wán wèn tí tā xiǎng dōu méi xiǎng dá àn jiù tuō kǒu ér chū le
items.en: The teacher had only just asked the question when, without a moment's thought, he blurted out the answer.
items.why: Words that come out before you think are 脱口而出, and 想都没想 sets it up. 一丝不苟 would mean he was careful, the opposite; 讨价还价 and 一见钟情 have nothing to do with answering.

items.q: 这两只小狗长得___，我分不清谁是谁。
items.zh: 这两只小狗长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。
items.py: zhè liǎng zhī xiǎo gǒu zhǎng de yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù qīng shéi shì shéi
items.en: These two puppies look exactly alike; I cannot tell which is which.
items.why: Not telling them apart means they look identical: 长得一模一样. 各种各样 means many different kinds.

items.q: 我和她买了___的裙子，穿上以后像一对双胞胎。
items.zh: 我和她买了一模一样的裙子，穿上以后像一对双胞胎。
items.py: wǒ hé tā mǎi le yī mú yī yàng de qún zi chuān shàng yǐ hòu xiàng yī duì shuāng bāo tāi
items.en: She and I bought exactly the same skirt; when we wear them we look like twins.
items.why: Like twins means identical skirts: 一模一样 + 的 before the noun. The other options do not describe clothes.

items.q: 手机里有___的软件，有的用来学习，有的用来玩游戏。
items.zh: 手机里有各种各样的软件，有的用来学习，有的用来玩游戏。
items.py: shǒu jī lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de ruǎn jiàn yǒu de yòng lái xué xí yǒu de yòng lái wán yóu xì
items.en: The phone has all kinds of apps; some are for study and some for games.
items.why: 有的...有的 lists different kinds, so 各种各样的. 一模一样 would mean they are all the same.

items.q: 他想了一下，没有___，而是慢慢地回答了问题。
items.zh: 他想了一下，没有脱口而出，而是慢慢地回答了问题。
items.py: tā xiǎng le yī xià méi yǒu tuō kǒu ér chū ér shì màn màn de huí dá le wèn tí
items.en: He thought for a moment; he did not blurt it out but answered the question slowly.
items.why: 没有...而是 contrasts a considered answer with a thoughtless one: 脱口而出 is the thoughtless one. The other options do not describe how to answer.

items.q: 她___老板讨价还价了半天，最后才买下那台电脑。
items.zh: 她跟老板讨价还价了半天，最后才买下那台电脑。
items.py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le bàn tiān zuì hòu cái mǎi xià nà tái diàn nǎo
items.en: She haggled with the owner for ages before finally buying the computer.
items.why: 讨价还价 takes no object, so the other party is introduced with 跟. 把 and a bare object are wrong.

items.q: 她对着电脑屏幕小声___，好像在练习演讲。
items.zh: 她对着电脑屏幕小声自言自语，好像在练习演讲。
items.py: tā duì zhe diàn nǎo píng mù xiǎo shēng zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài liàn xí yǎn jiǎng
items.en: She mumbled to herself at the computer screen, as if practising a speech.
items.why: Quietly speaking to oneself is 自言自语. The other options need another person or are not about speaking.

items.s: 她跟老板讨价还价了很久，终于便宜了二十块。
items.s_py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú pián yi le èr shí kuài
items.zh: 她跟老板讨价还价了很久，终于便宜了二十块。
items.py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú pián yi le èr shí kuài
items.en: She haggled with the owner for a long time and finally got twenty yuan off.
items.why: Correct. The person you haggle with comes before the idiom with 跟, and 了 follows the idiom with a duration.

items.s: 他对着镜子脱口而出，好像在和自己说话。
items.s_py: tā duì zhe jìng zi tuō kǒu ér chū hǎo xiàng zài hé zì jǐ shuō huà
items.zh: 他对着镜子自言自语，好像在和自己说话。
items.py: tā duì zhe jìng zi zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài hé zì jǐ shuō huà
items.en: He talked to himself in the mirror, as if speaking to himself.
items.why: Talking to yourself at length is 自言自语. 脱口而出 means words slipping out before you think, a single blurted remark, not a conversation with yourself in the mirror.

items.q: 他___地改了几个字就交了，连题目都没看清楚。
items.zh: 他马马虎虎地改了几个字就交了，连题目都没看清楚。
items.py: tā mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ de gǎi le jǐ ge zì jiù jiāo le lián tí mù dōu méi kàn qīng chu
items.en: He changed a few characters carelessly and handed it in without even reading the question properly.
items.why: Not even reading the question shows careless work: 马马虎虎地. 一丝不苟, 聚精会神 and 废寝忘食 all describe diligence, which 连...都没 contradicts.

items.q: 这两个手机壳___一模一样，我分不清哪个是我的。
items.zh: 这两个手机壳一模一样，我分不清哪个是我的。
items.py: zhè liǎng ge shǒu jī ké yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù qīng nǎ ge shì wǒ de
items.en: These two phone cases are exactly alike; I cannot tell which is mine.
items.why: 一模一样 already means "exactly the same", so no degree word goes before it. 很, 非常 and 比较 would all be wrong.

items.q: 孩子们___兴高采烈地冲进了宠物店。
items.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地冲进了宠物店。
items.py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chōng jìn le chǒng wù diàn
items.en: The children rushed into the pet shop in high spirits.
items.why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme, so it is used bare with 地. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot precede it.

items.q: 我___那只小狗一见钟情。
items.zh: 我对那只小狗一见钟情。
items.py: wǒ duì nà zhī xiǎo gǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng
items.en: I fell for that puppy at first sight.
items.why: 一见钟情 takes no object, so what you fall for is put in front with 对. 把 only works with a verb that does something to its object, 给 marks a receiver, and with nothing the sentence has no link to 小狗.

items.q: 他说无论如何___要把这个游戏通关。
items.zh: 他说无论如何都要把这个游戏通关。
items.py: tā shuō wú lùn rú hé dōu yào bǎ zhè ge yóu xì tōng guān
items.en: He said he would finish this game no matter what.
items.why: 无论如何 is followed by 都 before the verb phrase. 却, 才 and 又 do not pair with it.

items.q: 他从没出过城，真的___一只井底之蛙。
items.zh: 他从没出过城，真的是一只井底之蛙。
items.py: tā cóng méi chū guò chéng zhēn de shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā
items.en: He has never left the city; he really is a frog in a well.
items.why: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so the verb 是 and a measure word are needed. 很, 非常 and 最 cannot go before a noun idiom.

items.q: 我买了一部和他___的手机。
items.zh: 我买了一部和他一模一样的手机。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī bù hé tā yī mú yī yàng de shǒu jī
items.en: I bought a phone exactly like his.
items.why: 和他 compares two things, and 一模一样 + 的 before the noun means "identical". 各种各样 means many kinds and cannot compare with 和他.

items.q: 这两个游戏的画面___一模一样，只是名字不同。
items.zh: 这两个游戏的画面完全一模一样，只是名字不同。
items.py: zhè liǎng ge yóu xì de huà miàn wán quán yī mú yī yàng zhǐ shì míng zi bù tóng
items.en: The graphics of these two games are exactly the same; only the names differ.
items.why: 完全 strengthens 一模一样. 很, 特别 and 比较 are degree words and cannot go before an idiom that already means "exactly".

items.q: 他的话前后___，我不知道该相信哪一句。
items.zh: 他的话前后自相矛盾，我不知道该相信哪一句。
items.py: tā de huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn wǒ bù zhī dào gāi xiāng xìn nǎ yī jù
items.en: His words contradict each other; I do not know which to believe.
items.why: Not knowing which statement to believe means he contradicts himself: 自相矛盾. The others describe feelings or attention.

items.q: 双胞胎姐妹穿着___的衣服，连颜色都一样。
items.zh: 双胞胎姐妹穿着一模一样的衣服，连颜色都一样。
items.py: shuāng bāo tāi jiě mèi chuān zhe yī mú yī yàng de yī fu lián yán sè dōu yī yàng
items.en: The twin sisters wore identical clothes, even the same colour.
items.why: Identical, even in colour, is 一模一样 + 的 before the noun. 各种各样 would mean many different kinds, which contradicts 颜色都一样.

items.s: 这个手机壳和那个很一模一样。
items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké hé nà ge hěn yī mú yī yàng
items.zh: 这个手机壳和那个一模一样。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké hé nà ge yī mú yī yàng
items.en: This phone case is exactly the same as that one.
items.why: 一模一样 already means "exactly the same", so 很 cannot be put before it.

items.s: 弟弟一见钟情了那只小猫。
items.s_py: dì di yī jiàn zhōng qíng le nà zhī xiǎo māo
items.zh: 弟弟对那只小猫一见钟情了。
items.py: dì di duì nà zhī xiǎo māo yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
items.en: My little brother fell for that kitten at first sight.
items.why: 一见钟情 cannot take an object. The one fallen for goes before it with 对.

items.s: 这两双运动鞋一模一样，价格却差很多。
items.s_py: zhè liǎng shuāng yùn dòng xié yī mú yī yàng jià gé què chā hěn duō
items.zh: 这两双运动鞋一模一样，价格却差很多。
items.py: zhè liǎng shuāng yùn dòng xié yī mú yī yàng jià gé què chā hěn duō
items.en: These two pairs of trainers are identical but the prices differ a lot.
items.why: Correct. 一模一样 is a predicate used bare; the contrast comes from 却, not from the idiom.

items.s: 这件事太不可思议了，我还以为是在做梦。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn shì tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì zài zuò mèng
items.zh: 这件事太不可思议了，我还以为是在做梦。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì zài zuò mèng
items.en: This is so incredible I thought I was dreaming.
items.why: Correct. Judgement idioms like 不可思议 can take 太...了, even though descriptive idioms cannot take a degree word.

items.q: 他的房间___的，衣服和书到处都是。
items.zh: 他的房间乱七八糟的，衣服和书到处都是。
items.py: tā de fáng jiān luàn qī bā zāo de yī fu hé shū dào chù dōu shì
items.en: His room is a total mess, with clothes and books everywhere.
items.why: Clothes and books everywhere describe a total mess, 乱七八糟. 一丝不苟 and 十全十美 describe the opposite: neat, careful, flawless.

items.q: 新搬来的邻居把楼道堆得___，大家都不高兴。
items.zh: 新搬来的邻居把楼道堆得乱七八糟，大家都不高兴。
items.py: xīn bān lái de lín jū bǎ lóu dào duī de luàn qī bā zāo dà jiā dōu bù gāo xìng
items.en: The new neighbour piled things up in the stairwell in a complete mess, and everyone was unhappy.
items.why: 堆得乱七八糟 says the stuff is piled up in a mess, which explains why people are unhappy. 十全十美 and 津津有味 cannot describe how things are piled up.

items.q: 妈妈说我做事___，连门都忘了锁。
items.zh: 妈妈说我做事马马虎虎，连门都忘了锁。
items.py: mā ma shuō wǒ zuò shì mǎ ma hǔ hǔ lián mén dōu wàng le suǒ
items.en: Mum says I'm careless; I even forgot to lock the door.
items.why: Forgetting to lock the door is the proof of careless work, 马马虎虎. The other three all praise care or effort and would not be followed by 连门都忘了锁.

items.q: 爸爸总是___，不是忘了带钥匙，就是忘了带手机。
items.zh: 爸爸总是丢三落四，不是忘了带钥匙，就是忘了带手机。
items.py: bà ba zǒng shì diū sān là sì bù shì wàng le dài yào shi jiù shì wàng le dài shǒu jī
items.en: Dad is always forgetting things: if it's not his keys, it's his phone.
items.why: Forgetting one thing after another is 丢三落四 (落 is là). 一丝不苟 is the opposite, and 半途而废 and 七上八下 do not describe forgetfulness.

items.q: 客人突然来了，妈妈___地收拾起客厅来。
items.zh: 客人突然来了，妈妈手忙脚乱地收拾起客厅来。
items.py: kè rén tū rán lái le mā ma shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de shōu shi qǐ kè tīng lái
items.en: The guests turned up suddenly, and Mum rushed around in a flap tidying the living room.
items.why: Sudden guests and a quick tidy-up give a flustered scramble, 手忙脚乱 + 地 before the verb. The distractors do not describe a way of tidying.

items.q: 小王上课___，一会儿看手机，一会儿看窗外。
items.zh: 小王上课三心二意，一会儿看手机，一会儿看窗外。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shàng kè sān xīn èr yì yī huì r kàn shǒu jī yī huì r kàn chuāng wài
items.en: Xiao Wang is half-hearted in class: one moment he looks at his phone, the next out of the window.
items.why: Switching attention from phone to window is 三心二意. 聚精会神 and 废寝忘食 mean total absorption and 一丝不苟 means meticulous care, all the opposite of this picture.

items.q: 你别___了，那首歌不是她唱的，是另一个歌手唱的。
items.zh: 你别张冠李戴了，那首歌不是她唱的，是另一个歌手唱的。
items.py: nǐ bié zhāng guān lǐ dài le nà shǒu gē bù shì tā chàng de shì lìng yī gè gē shǒu chàng de
items.en: Don't mix them up: she didn't sing that song, another singer did.
items.why: Crediting the song to the wrong singer is 张冠李戴, mixing up who did what. 画蛇添足 is adding something needless, which does not fit.

items.q: 这家饭店的服务员做事___，上错了三个菜。
items.zh: 这家饭店的服务员做事马马虎虎，上错了三个菜。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn diàn de fú wù yuán zuò shì mǎ ma hǔ hǔ shàng cuò le sān gè cài
items.en: The waiters at this restaurant are careless; they served three wrong dishes.
items.why: Three wrong dishes show careless work, 马马虎虎. 一丝不苟 and 十全十美 would be praise and contradict the mistakes.

items.q: “你的钢琴弹得怎么样？”“___，还要多练习。”
items.zh: “你的钢琴弹得怎么样？”“马马虎虎，还要多练习。”
items.py: nǐ de gāng qín tán de zěn me yàng mǎ ma hǔ hǔ hái yào duō liàn xí
items.en: “How is your piano playing?” “So-so; I need more practice.”
items.why: As a modest answer, 马马虎虎 means so-so, which is why 还要多练习 follows. 十全十美 (perfect) would contradict that.

items.q: 他学吉他___，一边弹一边玩手机。
items.zh: 他学吉他三心二意，一边弹一边玩手机。
items.py: tā xué jí tā sān xīn èr yì yī biān tán yī biān wán shǒu jī
items.en: He learns the guitar half-heartedly, playing while fiddling with his phone.
items.why: Playing while on the phone is divided attention, 三心二意. The other three mean full focus or total devotion.

items.q: 搬家那天，客厅里___的，到处都是箱子。
items.zh: 搬家那天，客厅里乱七八糟的，到处都是箱子。
items.py: bān jiā nà tiān kè tīng li luàn qī bā zāo de dào chù dōu shì xiāng zi
items.en: On moving day the living room was a mess, with boxes everywhere.
items.why: Boxes everywhere make the room 乱七八糟的. The other idioms describe manner or feeling, not the state of a room.

items.q: 这张照片的说明写错了人，把弟弟说成了哥哥，真是___。
items.zh: 这张照片的说明写错了人，把弟弟说成了哥哥，真是张冠李戴。
items.py: zhè zhāng zhào piàn de shuō míng xiě cuò le rén bǎ dì di shuō chéng le gē ge zhēn shì zhāng guān lǐ dài
items.en: The caption names the wrong person, calling the younger brother the older one; a real mix-up.
items.why: Giving one person's identity to another is exactly 张冠李戴 (hat of Zhang on Li). The other idioms have nothing to do with a wrong attribution.

items.q: 我一向___，所以出门前都要检查一遍包。
items.zh: 我一向丢三落四，所以出门前都要检查一遍包。
items.py: wǒ yī xiàng diū sān là sì suǒ yǐ chū mén qián dōu yào jiǎn chá yī biàn bāo
items.en: I've always been forgetful, so I check my bag before I leave the house.
items.why: Checking the bag is the reaction to being forgetful, 丢三落四. The distractors do not give a reason for checking.

items.q: 闹钟没响，我___地穿好衣服，没吃早饭就冲出了门。
items.zh: 闹钟没响，我手忙脚乱地穿好衣服，没吃早饭就冲出了门。
items.py: nào zhōng méi xiǎng wǒ shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de chuān hǎo yī fu méi chī zǎo fàn jiù chōng chū le mén
items.en: The alarm didn't go off, so I flung my clothes on in a panic and dashed out without breakfast.
items.why: Dashing out with no breakfast describes a panicked rush, 手忙脚乱. 小心翼翼 (very carefully) and the happy or relishing idioms clash with the hurry.

items.q: 地铁里大家都在看手机，只有那个学生___地看书。
items.zh: 地铁里大家都在看手机，只有那个学生聚精会神地看书。
items.py: dì tiě li dà jiā dōu zài kàn shǒu jī zhǐ yǒu nà ge xué sheng jù jīng huì shén de kàn shū
items.en: On the metro everyone is on their phone; only that student is reading with total concentration.
items.why: Reading while everyone else is distracted points to full concentration, 聚精会神 + 地. The others do not fit quiet reading.

items.q: 为了考上大学，他___地复习，连周末都不休息。
items.zh: 为了考上大学，他废寝忘食地复习，连周末都不休息。
items.py: wèi le kǎo shàng dà xué tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de fù xí lián zhōu mò dōu bù xiū xi
items.en: To get into university he revised like mad, not even resting at the weekend.
items.why: Not even resting at the weekend shows he forgets sleep and food, 废寝忘食. 三心二意 and 无所谓 are the opposite of this effort.

items.q: 这家建筑公司做事___，每一块砖都要检查三遍。
items.zh: 这家建筑公司做事一丝不苟，每一块砖都要检查三遍。
items.py: zhè jiā jiàn zhù gōng sī zuò shì yī sī bù gǒu měi yī kuài zhuān dōu yào jiǎn chá sān biàn
items.en: This construction company is meticulous: every brick is checked three times.
items.why: Checking every brick three times is meticulous care, 一丝不苟. All three distractors are careless, the opposite.

items.q: 这次演出很重要，我们一定要___。
items.zh: 这次演出很重要，我们一定要全力以赴。
items.py: zhè cì yǎn chū hěn zhòng yào wǒ men yī dìng yào quán lì yǐ fù
items.en: This performance matters, so we must give it everything.
items.why: An important event calls for going all out, 全力以赴. 半途而废 (giving up halfway) after 一定要 would be absurd.

items.q: 他学了三个月的小提琴，觉得太难就不学了，真是___。
items.zh: 他学了三个月的小提琴，觉得太难就不学了，真是半途而废。
items.py: tā xué le sān gè yuè de xiǎo tí qín jué de tài nán jiù bù xué le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
items.en: He learned the violin for three months, found it too hard and quit; what a case of giving up halfway.
items.why: Quitting because it is hard is 半途而废. 全力以赴 and 一丝不苟 praise effort, and 熟能生巧 is about improving through practice.

items.q: 为了买到演唱会的票，他___地托朋友帮忙。
items.zh: 为了买到演唱会的票，他千方百计地托朋友帮忙。
items.py: wèi le mǎi dào yǎn chàng huì de piào tā qiān fāng bǎi jì de tuō péng you bāng máng
items.en: To get a concert ticket he tried every possible way, asking friends for help.
items.why: Trying every route to reach a goal is 千方百计. 无所谓 (doesn't matter) contradicts 为了买到票.

items.q: 写新闻报道要___，不能夸大。
items.zh: 写新闻报道要实事求是，不能夸大。
items.py: xiě xīn wén bào dào yào shí shì qiú shì bù néng kuā dà
items.en: News reports must stick to the facts and not exaggerate.
items.why: Not exaggerating means sticking to the facts, 实事求是. The distractors describe moods or giving up, not a standard for writing.

items.q: 他看书___，连我走进房间都没发现。
items.zh: 他看书聚精会神，连我走进房间都没发现。
items.py: tā kàn shū jù jīng huì shén lián wǒ zǒu jìn fáng jiān dōu méi fā xiàn
items.en: He read with such concentration that he didn't even notice me come into the room.
items.why: Not noticing someone enter is the result of full concentration, 聚精会神. 三心二意 would mean he is easily distracted, so he would notice.

items.q: 老师说，学外语不能___，要坚持每天练习。
items.zh: 老师说，学外语不能半途而废，要坚持每天练习。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō xué wài yǔ bù néng bàn tú ér fèi yào jiān chí měi tiān liàn xí
items.en: The teacher says you mustn't give up halfway when learning a language; keep practising every day.
items.why: The advice to keep going every day warns against 半途而废. The other idioms do not connect to persisting.

items.q: 为了写好这本小说，作家___地工作了两年。
items.zh: 为了写好这本小说，作家废寝忘食地工作了两年。
items.py: wèi le xiě hǎo zhè běn xiǎo shuō zuò jiā fèi qǐn wàng shí de gōng zuò le liǎng nián
items.en: To write this novel well, the author worked for two years, forgetting to eat and sleep.
items.why: Two years of obsessive work is 废寝忘食 + 地 before 工作. The distractors cannot modify a verb of working this way.

items.q: 她修改歌词时___，一个字也不放过。
items.zh: 她修改歌词时一丝不苟，一个字也不放过。
items.py: tā xiū gǎi gē cí shí yī sī bù gǒu yī gè zì yě bù fàng guò
items.en: She is meticulous when revising lyrics, letting not a single word slip by.
items.why: Not letting one word pass is meticulousness, 一丝不苟. 马马虎虎 here would be careless, which contradicts 一个字也不放过.

items.q: 房东___想把房子租出去，价钱一降再降。
items.zh: 房东千方百计想把房子租出去，价钱一降再降。
items.py: fáng dōng qiān fāng bǎi jì xiǎng bǎ fáng zi zū chū qù jià qián yī jiàng zài jiàng
items.en: The landlord is trying every trick to rent the flat out, lowering the price again and again.
items.why: Dropping the price again and again shows he is trying every possible way, 千方百计. 无所谓 would mean he doesn't care, the opposite.

items.q: 足球赛已经开始了，球员们___，都想赢。
items.zh: 足球赛已经开始了，球员们全力以赴，都想赢。
items.py: zú qiú sài yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qiú yuán men quán lì yǐ fù dōu xiǎng yíng
items.en: The match has begun and the players give it everything, all wanting to win.
items.why: Everyone wanting to win means giving everything, 全力以赴. 无所谓 (don't care) and 半途而废 contradict 都想赢.

items.q: 孩子们听说周末去动物园，一个个___。
items.zh: 孩子们听说周末去动物园，一个个兴高采烈。
items.py: hái zi men tīng shuō zhōu mò qù dòng wù yuán yī gè gè xìng gāo cǎi liè
items.en: The children heard they were going to the zoo at the weekend and were all in high spirits.
items.why: A treat makes the children happy, 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety, never joy.

items.q: 她看着电影，___地吃着爆米花。
items.zh: 她看着电影，津津有味地吃着爆米花。
items.py: tā kàn zhe diàn yǐng jīn jīn yǒu wèi de chī zhe bào mǐ huā
items.en: She ate popcorn with relish as she watched the film.
items.why: Eating something with obvious enjoyment is 津津有味 + 地. The others do not describe a way of eating.

items.q: 演唱会明天就开始了，我___想听她唱新歌。
items.zh: 演唱会明天就开始了，我迫不及待想听她唱新歌。
items.py: yǎn chàng huì míng tiān jiù kāi shǐ le wǒ pò bù jí dài xiǎng tīng tā chàng xīn gē
items.en: The concert is tomorrow and I can't wait to hear her sing the new songs.
items.why: Eager anticipation of tomorrow is 迫不及待. The distractors do not express eagerness.

items.q: 他___地抱着刚出生的女儿，生怕弄疼她。
items.zh: 他小心翼翼地抱着刚出生的女儿，生怕弄疼她。
items.py: tā xiǎo xīn yì yì de bào zhe gāng chū shēng de nǚ ér shēng pà nòng téng tā
items.en: He held his newborn daughter very carefully, afraid of hurting her.
items.why: 生怕 (afraid that) calls for great care, 小心翼翼. The distractors cannot describe how one holds a baby.

items.q: 明天就要考试了，我心里___的，晚上睡不着。
items.zh: 明天就要考试了，我心里七上八下的，晚上睡不着。
items.py: míng tiān jiù yào kǎo shì le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo
items.en: The exam is tomorrow; I'm on edge and can't sleep tonight.
items.why: Nervous before an exam, with trouble sleeping, is 心里七上八下. 兴高采烈 is joy and does not cause sleeplessness here.

items.q: 听完导游的讲解，我才___：原来这座老房子是一百年前的火车站。
items.zh: 听完导游的讲解，我才恍然大悟：原来这座老房子是一百年前的火车站。
items.py: tīng wán dǎo yóu de jiǎng jiě wǒ cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zhè zuò lǎo fáng zi shì yī bǎi nián qián de huǒ chē zhàn
items.en: Only after the guide's explanation did it dawn on me: this old house was a railway station a hundred years ago.
items.why: An explanation followed by 原来 gives sudden understanding, 恍然大悟. The other three are feelings, not realisations.

items.q: 看到最后一幕，我___，原来凶手一直就在身边。
items.zh: 看到最后一幕，我恍然大悟，原来凶手一直就在身边。
items.py: kàn dào zuì hòu yī mù wǒ huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái xiōng shǒu yī zhí jiù zài shēn biān
items.en: At the last scene it suddenly clicked: the killer had been right beside us all along.
items.why: 原来 introduces what the viewer suddenly understands, so 恍然大悟. The distractors do not mean realising something.

items.q: 她第一次在电影院见到他，就对他___了。
items.zh: 她第一次在电影院见到他，就对他一见钟情了。
items.py: tā dì yī cì zài diàn yǐng yuàn jiàn dào tā jiù duì tā yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
items.en: The first time she saw him in the cinema, she fell for him at first sight.
items.why: Falling in love on first meeting is 一见钟情, with 对 + person before it. The others cannot follow 对他.

items.q: 我对这座海边的小城___，决定在这里住下来。
items.zh: 我对这座海边的小城一见钟情，决定在这里住下来。
items.py: wǒ duì zhè zuò hǎi biān de xiǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng jué dìng zài zhè lǐ zhù xià lái
items.en: I fell in love with this little seaside town at first sight and decided to settle here.
items.why: Instant love for a place leads to the decision to stay: 对…一见钟情. The other idioms give no reason to move there.

items.q: 爷爷看京剧看得___，连晚饭都忘了吃。
items.zh: 爷爷看京剧看得津津有味，连晚饭都忘了吃。
items.py: yé ye kàn jīng jù kàn de jīn jīn yǒu wèi lián wǎn fàn dōu wàng le chī
items.en: Grandpa watched Peking opera with such relish that he forgot his dinner.
items.why: 看得津津有味 means watching with great enjoyment, which explains forgetting dinner. 莫名其妙 would mean he found it baffling and would not be so absorbed.

items.q: 我___地想回家，看看三年没见的父母。
items.zh: 我迫不及待地想回家，看看三年没见的父母。
items.py: wǒ pò bù jí dài de xiǎng huí jiā kàn kan sān nián méi jiàn de fù mǔ
items.en: I can't wait to go home and see my parents, whom I haven't seen for three years.
items.why: Three years apart explains impatience, 迫不及待. The other idioms do not express longing.

items.q: 他们昨天还好好的，今天却___地吵起架来。
items.zh: 他们昨天还好好的，今天却莫名其妙地吵起架来。
items.py: tā men zuó tiān hái hǎo hǎo de jīn tiān què mò míng qí miào de chǎo qǐ jià lái
items.en: They were fine yesterday, but today they started quarrelling for no apparent reason.
items.why: A quarrel after a good day, with no reason, is 莫名其妙地. 理所当然 would say the quarrel was only natural, which 却 rules out.

items.q: 这么小的孩子就能自己弹完一首钢琴曲，真___。
items.zh: 这么小的孩子就能自己弹完一首钢琴曲，真不可思议。
items.py: zhè me xiǎo de hái zi jiù néng zì jǐ tán wán yī shǒu gāng qín qǔ zhēn bù kě sī yì
items.en: A child this small can play a whole piano piece on their own; it's amazing.
items.why: Amazement at something surprising is 不可思议. 理所当然 and 无所谓 would treat it as normal or unimportant.

items.q: 孩子长大了就要离开家，这是___的事。
items.zh: 孩子长大了就要离开家，这是理所当然的事。
items.py: hái zi zhǎng dà le jiù yào lí kāi jiā zhè shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de shì
items.en: Children leave home when they grow up; that is only natural.
items.why: 是…的事 with something that goes without saying takes 理所当然. 莫名其妙的事 would call it senseless, which clashes with the sentence.

items.q: “我们去看电影还是去逛街？”“都___，你决定吧。”
items.zh: “我们去看电影还是去逛街？”“都无所谓，你决定吧。”
items.py: wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng hái shi qù guàng jiē dōu wú suǒ wèi nǐ jué dìng ba
items.en: “Shall we see a film or go shopping?” “Either is fine, you decide.”
items.why: 都无所谓 means both options are fine with me, so the choice is yours. The other idioms make no sense as an answer to a choice question.

items.q: 这家餐厅的菜、服务和环境都很好，几乎___。
items.zh: 这家餐厅的菜、服务和环境都很好，几乎十全十美。
items.py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài fú wù hé huán jìng dōu hěn hǎo jī hū shí quán shí měi
items.en: The food, service and atmosphere at this restaurant are all good; it's almost perfect.
items.why: Everything being good gives 十全十美 (perfect). The distractors are negative or lukewarm and clash with 都很好.

items.q: 他很有钱，这点房租对他来说只是___。
items.zh: 他很有钱，这点房租对他来说只是九牛一毛。
items.py: tā hěn yǒu qián zhè diǎn fáng zū duì tā lái shuō zhǐ shì jiǔ niú yī máo
items.en: He's rich; this bit of rent is a drop in the ocean for him.
items.why: A tiny amount compared with great wealth is 九牛一毛. 十全十美 means perfect and cannot describe a sum of money.

items.q: ___，我明天都要去机场送你。
items.zh: 无论如何，我明天都要去机场送你。
items.py: wú lùn rú hé wǒ míng tiān dōu yào qù jī chǎng sòng nǐ
items.en: No matter what, I'm going to the airport to see you off tomorrow.
items.why: 无论如何 opens the sentence and pairs with 都 before the verb. The others cannot introduce a firm resolve.

items.q: 这部电影的结尾很___，我看了两遍还是不懂。
items.zh: 这部电影的结尾很莫名其妙，我看了两遍还是不懂。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng de jié wěi hěn mò míng qí miào wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn hái shi bù dǒng
items.en: The ending of this film is baffling; I watched it twice and still don't get it.
items.why: Not understanding even after two viewings means the ending is baffling, 莫名其妙. The distractors are praise or approval and do not fit 不懂.

items.q: 他今天突然送我一束花，真让我觉得___。
items.zh: 他今天突然送我一束花，真让我觉得莫名其妙。
items.py: tā jīn tiān tū rán sòng wǒ yī shù huā zhēn ràng wǒ jué de mò míng qí miào
items.en: He suddenly gave me a bunch of flowers today, which left me puzzled.
items.why: A sudden gift with no explanation leaves one puzzled, 莫名其妙. The others cannot follow 觉得 in this sense.

items.q: 他一天读完三本书，对我来说简直___。
items.zh: 他一天读完三本书，对我来说简直不可思议。
items.py: tā yī tiān dú wán sān běn shū duì wǒ lái shuō jiǎn zhí bù kě sī yì
items.en: He finishes three books in a day; to me that's simply unbelievable.
items.why: 简直 plus amazement gives 不可思议. 理所当然 would say it is only natural, which 对我来说简直 does not.

items.q: 住在哪个城区我都___，只要离地铁站近就行。
items.zh: 住在哪个城区我都无所谓，只要离地铁站近就行。
items.py: zhù zài nǎ ge chéng qū wǒ dōu wú suǒ wèi zhǐ yào lí dì tiě zhàn jìn jiù xíng
items.en: I don't mind which district I live in, as long as it's close to a metro station.
items.why: 都无所谓 says every option is fine with me. 只要…就行 sets the only condition.

items.q: 这部电影到这里结束最好，后面又加了一段，真是___。
items.zh: 这部电影到这里结束最好，后面又加了一段，真是画蛇添足。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng dào zhè lǐ jié shù zuì hǎo hòu miàn yòu jiā le yī duàn zhēn shì huà shé tiān zú
items.en: The film should have ended here; tacking on another section afterwards just spoiled it.
items.why: Adding something unneeded that spoils a good result is 画蛇添足. 亡羊补牢 is fixing a loss, which is not what happened.

items.q: 你跟他讲古典音乐，就是___，他一点兴趣也没有。
items.zh: 你跟他讲古典音乐，就是对牛弹琴，他一点兴趣也没有。
items.py: nǐ gēn tā jiǎng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè jiù shì duì niú tán qín tā yī diǎn xìng qù yě méi yǒu
items.en: Talking classical music to him is wasted effort; he has no interest at all.
items.why: Telling something to someone who cannot or does not care to appreciate it is 对牛弹琴. 一点兴趣也没有 gives the reason.

items.q: 他一直坐在家里等好工作来找他，真是___。
items.zh: 他一直坐在家里等好工作来找他，真是守株待兔。
items.py: tā yī zhí zuò zài jiā li děng hǎo gōng zuò lái zhǎo tā zhēn shì shǒu zhū dài tù
items.en: He just sits at home waiting for a good job to come to him; he's waiting for luck to strike.
items.why: Passively waiting for luck is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 is repairing after a loss and involves action.

items.q: 邻居家被偷以后，小区才安上了新门锁，虽然晚了点，也算___。
items.zh: 邻居家被偷以后，小区才安上了新门锁，虽然晚了点，也算亡羊补牢。
items.py: lín jū jiā bèi tōu yǐ hòu xiǎo qū cái ān shàng le xīn mén suǒ suī rán wǎn le diǎn yě suàn wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.en: Only after the neighbours were burgled did the estate fit new locks; a bit late, but better late than never.
items.why: Fixing things after a loss is 亡羊补牢, and 虽然晚了点, 也算 shows it is still worth doing. 守株待兔 is passive waiting.

items.q: 他从没离开过这个小城，却说外面的世界不过如此，真是个___。
items.zh: 他从没离开过这个小城，却说外面的世界不过如此，真是个井底之蛙。
items.py: tā cóng méi lí kāi guò zhè ge xiǎo chéng què shuō wài miàn de shì jiè bù guò rú cǐ zhēn shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā
items.en: He has never left this town yet says the outside world is nothing special; a real frog in a well.
items.why: Someone who judges the world without having seen it is a 井底之蛙, a noun after 个. The other idioms cannot name a type of person.

items.q: 他说自己很喜欢安静，却天天把音乐开得很大声，这不是___吗？
items.zh: 他说自己很喜欢安静，却天天把音乐开得很大声，这不是自相矛盾吗？
items.py: tā shuō zì jǐ hěn xǐ huan ān jìng què tiān tiān bǎ yīn yuè kāi de hěn dà shēng zhè bù shì zì xiāng máo dùn ma
items.en: He says he likes quiet but plays his music loud every day; isn't that contradictory?
items.why: His words and his behaviour clash with each other, which is 自相矛盾. The other story idioms do not describe a contradiction.

items.q: 你对一个三岁的孩子讲这么多大道理，不是___吗？
items.zh: 你对一个三岁的孩子讲这么多大道理，不是对牛弹琴吗？
items.py: nǐ duì yī gè sān suì de hái zi jiǎng zhè me duō dà dào lǐ bù shì duì niú tán qín ma
items.en: Isn't it pointless to preach so many principles to a three-year-old?
items.why: A three-year-old cannot appreciate big principles, so talking is wasted: 对牛弹琴. 亡羊补牢 is about repairing a loss.

items.q: 想在这个城市找到好房子，不能在家里___，要多去看看。
items.zh: 想在这个城市找到好房子，不能在家里守株待兔，要多去看看。
items.py: xiǎng zài zhè ge chéng shì zhǎo dào hǎo fáng zi bù néng zài jiā li shǒu zhū dài tù yào duō qù kàn kan
items.en: To find a good flat in this city you can't just sit at home hoping; you must go and look.
items.why: Sitting at home waiting for luck is 守株待兔, and 要多去看看 gives the contrast. 亡羊补牢 would approve of fixing, not of passivity.

items.q: 这间屋子已经很漂亮了，再挂一幅画就成了___。
items.zh: 这间屋子已经很漂亮了，再挂一幅画就成了画蛇添足。
items.py: zhè jiān wū zi yǐ jīng hěn piào liang le zài guà yī fú huà jiù chéng le huà shé tiān zú
items.en: This room is already pretty; hanging one more picture would be overdoing it.
items.why: Adding to what is already good, and spoiling it, is 画蛇添足. The other story idioms do not mean spoiling by adding.

items.q: 他以前从不运动，生病以后才开始锻炼身体，这也是___。
items.zh: 他以前从不运动，生病以后才开始锻炼身体，这也是亡羊补牢。
items.py: tā yǐ qián cóng bù yùn dòng shēng bìng yǐ hòu cái kāi shǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhè yě shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.en: He never exercised before; he only started after falling ill, but it's better late than never.
items.why: Taking action after a problem has appeared is 亡羊补牢, and it is still worthwhile. 守株待兔 is waiting passively, which he did not do.

items.q: 你下周要开车回老家，路上要小心，祝你___。
items.zh: 你下周要开车回老家，路上要小心，祝你一路平安。
items.py: nǐ xià zhōu yào kāi chē huí lǎo jiā lù shang yào xiǎo xīn zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.en: You're driving back to your home town next week; take care, and have a safe journey.
items.why: A wish for someone who is travelling is 祝你一路平安. The other sayings cannot follow 祝你.

items.q: 过年了，我给远方的朋友发信息：“祝你新年快乐，___！”
items.zh: 过年了，我给远方的朋友发信息：“祝你新年快乐，万事如意！”
items.py: guò nián le wǒ gěi yuǎn fāng de péng you fā xìn xī zhù nǐ xīn nián kuài lè wàn shì rú yì
items.en: It's New Year and I message a friend far away: “Happy New Year, and all the best!”
items.why: A general New Year wish is 万事如意 (everything as you wish). The other idioms are not wishes.

items.q: 别人都说那个古镇很美，我去了才知道，真是___。
items.zh: 别人都说那个古镇很美，我去了才知道，真是百闻不如一见。
items.py: bié rén dōu shuō nà ge gǔ zhèn hěn měi wǒ qù le cái zhī dào zhēn shì bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
items.en: Everyone said that old town was beautiful, and only when I went did I understand: seeing is believing.
items.why: Hearing about it versus going there is exactly 百闻不如一见. 熟能生巧 is about practice.

items.q: 这首曲子我每天练一小时，现在弹得越来越好了，真是___。
items.zh: 这首曲子我每天练一小时，现在弹得越来越好了，真是熟能生巧。
items.py: zhè shǒu qǔ zi wǒ měi tiān liàn yī xiǎo shí xiàn zài tán de yuè lái yuè hǎo le zhēn shì shú néng shēng qiǎo
items.en: I practise this piece an hour every day and play it better and better; practice makes perfect.
items.why: Getting better through daily practice is 熟能生巧. 百闻不如一见 is about seeing for yourself.

items.q: 刚搬到新城市，当地人都吃得很辣，我也___，学着吃辣。
items.zh: 刚搬到新城市，当地人都吃得很辣，我也入乡随俗，学着吃辣。
items.py: gāng bān dào xīn chéng shì dāng dì rén dōu chī de hěn là wǒ yě rù xiāng suí sú xué zhe chī là
items.en: Having just moved to a new city where the locals eat very spicy food, I do as the Romans do and learn to eat spicy.
items.why: Adopting local customs in a new place is 入乡随俗, which is what 学着吃辣 shows. 一举两得 is about two gains from one action.

items.q: 骑自行车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是___。
items.zh: 骑自行车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
items.py: qí zì xíng chē shàng bān jì shěng qián yòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
items.en: Cycling to work saves money and keeps you fit; it kills two birds with one stone.
items.why: Two benefits from one action, 既…又…, is 一举两得. The other sayings do not describe a double gain.

items.q: 去外地旅行前，朋友对我说：“___，到了给我发信息。”
items.zh: 去外地旅行前，朋友对我说：“一路平安，到了给我发信息。”
items.py: qù wài dì lǚ xíng qián péng you duì wǒ shuō yī lù píng ān dào le gěi wǒ fā xìn xī
items.en: Before my trip out of town, my friend said: “Have a safe journey, and message me when you arrive.”
items.why: The speaker is about to travel, so the farewell wish is 一路平安, and 到了给我发信息 fits it.

items.q: 住进新家以后，我们参加了邻居的聚会，既认识了朋友又练习了汉语，真是___。
items.zh: 住进新家以后，我们参加了邻居的聚会，既认识了朋友又练习了汉语，真是一举两得。
items.py: zhù jìn xīn jiā yǐ hòu wǒ men cān jiā le lín jū de jù huì jì rèn shi le péng you yòu liàn xí le hàn yǔ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
items.en: After moving into the new home we went to the neighbours' party, making friends and practising Chinese at once; two birds with one stone.
items.why: Two gains from one party is 一举两得. The distractors are negative judgments and do not fit two benefits.

items.q: 在旧货市场买东西，大家都喜欢和老板___。
items.zh: 在旧货市场买东西，大家都喜欢和老板讨价还价。
items.py: zài jiù huò shì chǎng mǎi dōng xi dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià
items.en: At the second-hand market everyone likes to haggle with the stallholders.
items.why: 和老板 + 讨价还价 (还 is huán) is haggling with someone. The distractors cannot follow 和老板.

items.q: 书店里有___的书，从小说到漫画都有。
items.zh: 书店里有各种各样的书，从小说到漫画都有。
items.py: shū diàn li yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū cóng xiǎo shuō dào màn huà dōu yǒu
items.en: The bookshop has all kinds of books, from novels to comics.
items.why: From novels to comics means many kinds: 各种各样的 before the noun. 一模一样的书 would mean identical books, which contradicts the range.

items.q: 他一个人坐在公园里___，好像在背课文。
items.zh: 他一个人坐在公园里自言自语，好像在背课文。
items.py: tā yī gè rén zuò zài gōng yuán li zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài bèi kè wén
items.en: He sat alone in the park muttering to himself, as if learning a text by heart.
items.why: Alone and talking, as if reciting, is 自言自语. 讨价还价 needs someone to haggle with, which 一个人 rules out, and 脱口而出 needs a remark that slips out.

items.q: 我没想清楚，那句话就___了，现在很后悔。
items.zh: 我没想清楚，那句话就脱口而出了，现在很后悔。
items.py: wǒ méi xiǎng qīng chu nà jù huà jiù tuō kǒu ér chū le xiàn zài hěn hòu huǐ
items.en: I hadn't thought it through and the remark just slipped out; now I regret it.
items.why: Saying something without thinking, followed by regret, is 脱口而出. 自言自语 is talking to oneself and does not cause regret.

items.q: 这两个杯子颜色大小都___，我分不出哪个是我的。
items.zh: 这两个杯子颜色大小都一模一样，我分不出哪个是我的。
items.py: zhè liǎng gè bēi zi yán sè dà xiǎo dōu yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù chū nǎ ge shì wǒ de
items.en: These two cups are exactly alike in colour and size; I can't tell which is mine.
items.why: Not being able to tell them apart means they are identical, 一模一样 (模 is mú). 各种各样 would mean many kinds.

items.q: 我和哥哥的手机___，所以常常拿错。
items.zh: 我和哥哥的手机一模一样，所以常常拿错。
items.py: wǒ hé gē ge de shǒu jī yī mú yī yàng suǒ yǐ cháng cháng ná cuò
items.en: My brother's phone and mine are identical, so we often pick up the wrong one.
