items.why: Picking up the wrong phone is the result of identical phones, 一模一样. 各种各样 would mean different kinds, which would not cause the confusion.

items.q: 她和卖水果的阿姨___了半天，最后便宜了两块钱。
items.zh: 她和卖水果的阿姨讨价还价了半天，最后便宜了两块钱。
items.py: tā hé mài shuǐ guǒ de ā yí tǎo jià huán jià le bàn tiān zuì hòu pián yi le liǎng kuài qián
items.en: She haggled with the fruit seller for ages and got two yuan off in the end.
items.why: Getting a price cut after a long exchange is 讨价还价, with 和 + person. The others do not produce a lower price.

items.q: 这两个房间的布置___一模一样。
items.zh: 这两个房间的布置一模一样。
items.py: zhè liǎng gè fáng jiān de bù zhì yī mú yī yàng
items.en: The decoration of these two rooms is exactly the same.
items.why: 一模一样 already means exactly the same, so 很 cannot be added. Leave the blank empty and use it bare.

items.q: 他___那个女孩一见钟情了。
items.zh: 他对那个女孩一见钟情了。
items.py: tā duì nà ge nǚ hái yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
items.en: He fell for that girl at first sight.
items.why: 一见钟情 takes no object, so the person is introduced by 对 before it. 把 and a bare noun both put the girl in the wrong slot.

items.q: 买菜的时候，妈妈总是___卖菜的人讨价还价。
items.zh: 买菜的时候，妈妈总是和卖菜的人讨价还价。
items.py: mǎi cài de shí hou mā ma zǒng shì hé mài cài de rén tǎo jià huán jià
items.en: When shopping for vegetables, Mum always haggles with the seller.
items.why: 讨价还价 takes no direct object, so the other party is introduced with 和 (or 跟). 把 would turn the seller into the thing being handled.

items.q: 他从不出远门，却看不起别的城市，简直就是一只___。
items.zh: 他从不出远门，却看不起别的城市，简直就是一只井底之蛙。
items.py: tā cóng bù chū yuǎn mén què kàn bù qǐ bié de chéng shì jiǎn zhí jiù shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā
items.en: He never travels far yet looks down on other cities; he's simply a frog in a well.
items.why: After 一只 a noun is needed, and 井底之蛙 is the noun idiom for a narrow-minded person. The others are not nouns for people.

items.q: 世界上没有___的家庭，每个家庭都有小矛盾。
items.zh: 世界上没有十全十美的家庭，每个家庭都有小矛盾。
items.py: shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shí quán shí měi de jiā tíng měi gè jiā tíng dōu yǒu xiǎo máo dùn
items.en: There is no perfect family in the world; every family has small quarrels.
items.why: 十全十美 + 的 before a noun means perfect, which matches 都有小矛盾. The other idioms cannot modify 家庭.

items.q: 孩子们___兴高采烈地唱着歌。
items.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地唱着歌。
items.py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chàng zhe gē
items.en: The children were singing in high spirits.
items.why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme, so it does not take 很 or 太. Use it bare before 地 and the verb.

items.s: 我一见钟情了那个歌手。
items.s_py: wǒ yī jiàn zhōng qíng le nà ge gē shǒu
items.zh: 我对那个歌手一见钟情了。
items.py: wǒ duì nà ge gē shǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
items.en: I fell for that singer at first sight.
items.why: 一见钟情 cannot take a direct object. The person goes in front with 对.

items.s: 这两家店的牌子很一模一样。
items.s_py: zhè liǎng jiā diàn de pái zi hěn yī mú yī yàng
items.zh: 这两家店的牌子一模一样。
items.py: zhè liǎng jiā diàn de pái zi yī mú yī yàng
items.en: The signs of these two shops are exactly the same.
items.why: 一模一样 already means exactly the same, so 很 in front of it is wrong.

items.s: 妈妈在菜市场讨价还价卖菜的人。
items.s_py: mā ma zài cài shì chǎng tǎo jià huán jià mài cài de rén
items.zh: 妈妈在菜市场跟卖菜的人讨价还价。
items.py: mā ma zài cài shì chǎng gēn mài cài de rén tǎo jià huán jià
items.en: Mum haggles with the vegetable seller at the market.
items.why: 讨价还价 takes no object; the other party needs 跟 or 和 before the idiom.

items.s: 他很井底之蛙，从来没离开过这个村子。
items.s_py: tā hěn jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi lí kāi guò zhè ge cūn zi
items.zh: 他是只井底之蛙，从来没离开过这个村子。
items.py: tā shì zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi lí kāi guò zhè ge cūn zi
items.en: He's a frog in a well; he has never left this village.
items.why: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so it follows 是 plus a measure word, not 很.

items.s: 孩子们很兴高采烈地跑进了新房子。
items.s_py: hái zi men hěn xìng gāo cǎi liè de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
items.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地跑进了新房子。
items.py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
items.en: The children ran into the new house in high spirits.
items.why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme and does not take 很.

items.s: 明天你要参加考试，祝你一路平安！
items.s_py: míng tiān nǐ yào cān jiā kǎo shì zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.zh: 明天你要参加考试，祝你一切顺利！
items.py: míng tiān nǐ yào cān jiā kǎo shì zhù nǐ yī qiè shùn lì
items.en: You have an exam tomorrow; I wish you all the best!
items.why: 一路平安 is only said to someone setting off on a journey, and an exam is not a trip. Wish someone sitting an exam 一切顺利 (or 考试顺利).

items.s: 弟弟拿到新手机，七上八下地玩了一整天。
items.s_py: dì di ná dào xīn shǒu jī qī shàng bā xià de wán le yī zhěng tiān
items.zh: 弟弟拿到新手机，兴高采烈地玩了一整天。
items.py: dì di ná dào xīn shǒu jī xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán le yī zhěng tiān
items.en: Having got a new phone, my brother played with it happily all day.
items.why: 七上八下 is anxiety, never joy. A child delighted by a new phone is 兴高采烈.

items.s: 他从不复习，只盼着考试正好考他会的题，真是亡羊补牢。
items.s_py: tā cóng bù fù xí zhǐ pàn zhe kǎo shì zhèng hǎo kǎo tā huì de tí zhēn shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
items.zh: 他从不复习，只盼着考试正好考他会的题，真是守株待兔。
items.py: tā cóng bù fù xí zhǐ pàn zhe kǎo shì zhèng hǎo kǎo tā huì de tí zhēn shì shǒu zhū dài tù
items.en: He never revises and just hopes the exam happens to ask what he knows; pure waiting for luck.
items.why: Hoping luck will hand you the questions you know is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 means fixing things after a loss, and he is not fixing anything.

items.s: 他检查文件一丝不苟，错了好几个字也没发现。
items.s_py: tā jiǎn chá wén jiàn yī sī bù gǒu cuò le hǎo jǐ gè zì yě méi fā xiàn
items.zh: 他检查文件马马虎虎，错了好几个字也没发现。
items.py: tā jiǎn chá wén jiàn mǎ ma hǔ hǔ cuò le hǎo jǐ gè zì yě méi fā xiàn
items.en: He checked the document carelessly and missed several wrong characters.
items.why: 一丝不苟 means meticulous; missing several errors shows carelessness, 马马虎虎.

items.s: 他的房间乱七八糟的，书和衣服都放得整整齐齐。
items.s_py: tā de fáng jiān luàn qī bā zāo de shū hé yī fu dōu fàng de zhěng zhěng qí qí
items.zh: 他的房间干干净净的，书和衣服都放得整整齐齐。
items.py: tā de fáng jiān gān gān jìng jìng de shū hé yī fu dōu fàng de zhěng zhěng qí qí
items.en: His room is spotless, with books and clothes put away neatly.
items.why: 乱七八糟 means a total mess, which contradicts everything being put away neatly.

items.s: 他把小说写到一半就不写了，真是全力以赴。
items.s_py: tā bǎ xiǎo shuō xiě dào yī bàn jiù bù xiě le zhēn shì quán lì yǐ fù
items.zh: 他把小说写到一半就不写了，真是半途而废。
items.py: tā bǎ xiǎo shuō xiě dào yī bàn jiù bù xiě le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
items.en: He stopped writing the novel halfway; what a case of giving up midway.
items.why: Stopping halfway is 半途而废. 全力以赴 means giving everything and contradicts quitting.

items.s: 他对这座老城一见钟情，后来就留在那里工作了。
items.s_py: tā duì zhè zuò lǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng hòu lái jiù liú zài nà lǐ gōng zuò le
items.zh: 他对这座老城一见钟情，后来就留在那里工作了。
items.py: tā duì zhè zuò lǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng hòu lái jiù liú zài nà lǐ gōng zuò le
items.en: He fell for this old city at first sight and later stayed there to work.
items.why: Correct: 一见钟情 takes the place with 对 in front and no object after it.

items.s: 这两张地图完全一模一样。
items.s_py: zhè liǎng zhāng dì tú wán quán yī mú yī yàng
items.zh: 这两张地图完全一模一样。
items.py: zhè liǎng zhāng dì tú wán quán yī mú yī yàng
items.en: These two maps are completely identical.
items.why: Correct: 很 is wrong before 一模一样, but 完全 may strengthen it.

items.s: 她跟房东讨价还价，把房租降了两百块。
items.s_py: tā gēn fáng dōng tǎo jià huán jià bǎ fáng zū jiàng le liǎng bǎi kuài
items.zh: 她跟房东讨价还价，把房租降了两百块。
items.py: tā gēn fáng dōng tǎo jià huán jià bǎ fáng zū jiàng le liǎng bǎi kuài
items.en: She haggled with the landlord and got the rent down by two hundred yuan.
items.why: Correct: 跟 introduces the person, and 讨价还价 takes no object. Haggling with a landlord about rent is a fitting situation.

items.s: 他是个井底之蛙，以为自己的公司就是全世界。
items.s_py: tā shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā yǐ wéi zì jǐ de gōng sī jiù shì quán shì jiè
items.zh: 他是个井底之蛙，以为自己的公司就是全世界。
items.py: tā shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā yǐ wéi zì jǐ de gōng sī jiù shì quán shì jiè
items.en: He's a frog in a well, thinking his own company is the whole world.
items.why: Correct: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so it follows 是 with the measure 个, not 很. Thinking your small corner is the whole world is exactly its meaning.

items.s: 这部电影太不可思议了，我看了三遍。
items.s_py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
items.zh: 这部电影太不可思议了，我看了三遍。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
items.en: This film is just incredible; I've watched it three times.
items.why: Correct: judgment idioms like 不可思议 do take 太…了 or 很, unlike 一模一样 or 兴高采烈.

items.s: 明天你要坐火车回老家，祝你一路平安！
items.s_py: míng tiān nǐ yào zuò huǒ chē huí lǎo jiā zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.zh: 明天你要坐火车回老家，祝你一路平安！
items.py: míng tiān nǐ yào zuò huǒ chē huí lǎo jiā zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
items.en: You're taking the train back to your home town tomorrow; have a safe journey!
items.why: Correct: 一路平安 is the right wish for someone about to travel.

items.s: 听了老师的话，他才恍然大悟，原来自己一直弄错了。
items.s_py: tīng le lǎo shī de huà tā cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zì jǐ yī zhí nòng cuò le
items.zh: 听了老师的话，他才恍然大悟，原来自己一直弄错了。
items.py: tīng le lǎo shī de huà tā cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zì jǐ yī zhí nòng cuò le
items.en: After hearing the teacher, it suddenly dawned on him that he had had it wrong all along.
items.why: Correct: the teacher's words cause the sudden understanding, 恍然大悟, as this idiom needs a trigger.

items.s: 他心里七上八下地等着面试的结果。
items.s_py: tā xīn li qī shàng bā xià de děng zhe miàn shì de jié guǒ
items.zh: 他心里七上八下地等着面试的结果。
items.py: tā xīn li qī shàng bā xià de děng zhe miàn shì de jié guǒ
items.en: He waited for the interview result with a pounding heart.
items.why: Correct: 七上八下 is anxiety, and an interview result is a natural cause. 心里 and 地 before the verb are fine.

items.s: 她喜欢听各种各样的音乐，从摇滚到古典都听。
items.s_py: tā xǐ huan tīng gè zhǒng gè yàng de yīn yuè cóng yáo gǔn dào gǔ diǎn dōu tīng
items.zh: 她喜欢听各种各样的音乐，从摇滚到古典都听。
items.py: tā xǐ huan tīng gè zhǒng gè yàng de yīn yuè cóng yáo gǔn dào gǔ diǎn dōu tīng
items.en: She likes listening to all kinds of music, from rock to classical.
items.why: Correct: 各种各样 goes before 的 + noun, and the range from rock to classical matches its meaning.
